It’s Speaker Newt Gingrich with a couple of thoughts for you today.

I recently met with some of my friends over lunch to talk shop, and during this lunch you can probably guess what we talked about: _**politics.**_

We discussed how we’re going to hold onto the House, while flipping the Senate in November 2024. _**I think it’s safe to say that everyone at the table agrees that though we certainly have our work cut out for us**_ , we’re in a good position to successfully execute our goals.

A couple of things came up that I want to talk to you about today, one in particular: **our chances of flipping the long-held Democrat Senate seat in Montana.**

body:
Announcing the Rylee Linting Scholarship Program | | |
---
| |
---
| |
# Party of the Constitution
---
We would like to invite you and your county party to participate in a new program we're adding to the 2023 Mackinac Leadership Conference, scheduled for September 22nd-24th.
Thanks to the outstanding recruitment efforts of MIGOP Youth Vice Chair Rylee Linting, we now have a fantastic group of 120 young people in college that we would like to support and guide. These individuals, who symbolize the future of our party, are enthusiastic about learning and contributing to the Party of the Constitution.
To support the development of conservative Republicans, we plan to offer scholarships for attendance at the Mackinac Conference. This will provide an opportunity to participate in the political process alongside current party leaders and contribute to the event's presentation. Additionally, recipients will have the chance to volunteer in fundraising calls and other volunteer activities leading up to the event.
We are looking for sponsors to support these young individuals who have been awarded the Mackinac Scholarship at a reduced cost of $400. This scholarship will allow them to stay at the Grand Hotel for two nights, and your contribution will help cover the expenses of their meals during their stay.
Thank you for your efforts to restore Constitutional governance in Michigan.

clean_body: We're less than a week to go, and we need all hands on deck! | | The 2024 election will decide the future of our country. And young people will decide the outcome of the 2024 election. The youth vote could ensure we strengthen our democracy, restore abortion rights, and take more meaningful action to protect the climate. But young people can’t turnout in record numbers to vote for a better future if we aren’t even registered to vote. That's why, next week (09.17.23-09.23.23), the Young Democrats of America arecelebrating National Voter Registration Day & Week, and we need you to join us. ** — whether that's sharing resources, registering a friend, or hosting a registration drive.** | Mark your calendar for National Voter Registration Day, Tuesday, Sept. 19, 2023! Helpful tools for #NationalVoterRegistrationDay: ★ \- Use the NVRD website to get resources for hosting your own event. Step up to host a local or online event with your family, friends and neighbors to make sure everyone you know is registered! ★ \- Folks across the nation can check their registration status here.You will find everything you need to vote in your state's next election. ★ \- Follow us on social media to get reminders about next week! **GET TO KNOW VIVEK:** Vivek is an American entrepreneur, political and cultural thought leader, and New York Times bestselling author of **_Woke, Inc.: Inside Corporate America's Social Justice Scam_** , along with his second book, **_Nation of Victims: Identity Politics, the Death of Merit, and the Path Back to Excellence_**.

He has been a prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do through the front door under the Constitution.

Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." This advice set the course for his life: an accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. He went on to graduate summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund, then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where his team developed five drugs that went on to become FDA-approved.

In 2022, he founded Strive Asset Management, an Ohio-based firm, that takes direct aim at asset managers like BlackRock, State Street, Vanguard and others for their fiduciary breach of duty to maximize the wealth of their clients for Wokeism. Strive's mission is to restore the voices of everyday citizens in the American economy by leading companies to focus on excellence over politics.

We need strong leaders who will solve problems and put Montana - and America - FIRST. When I joined the Navy, I made a commitment not only to myself, but to my country. Our country. Those of you reading this today who served in the Armed Forces will know that the commitment we made to America when we joined up isn’t just for four, six, or even 20 years – it’s lifelong. During my time as a Navy SEAL, I was deployed to Iraq, Afghanistan, South America, and the Pacific – I’ve been involved in dozens of engagements with enemy forces. But, running to be Montana’s next U.S. Senator will be the toughest mission yet. Just look at where are as a nation. Since Joe Biden took office our once strong economy is no longer what it once was as we experience skyrocketing inflation, our borders are more porous than ever before, and the woke culture of the Left is tearing apart the very fabric of our society. body:
| | Please see a special message from our sponsor.
---
| | | | [](http://trk.faithandlibertymail.com/c/7/eyJhaSI6OTkyNjA2OTcsImUiOiJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSIsInJpIjoiMTM1MDI1NTcxMSIsInJxIjoiMDItYjIzMjU4LWYwOTYzZDA5NTQ4YTRkY2JhMGIxMjRjN2I0N2U3NjRkIiwicGgiOm51bGwsIm0iOmZhbHNlLCJ1aSI6IjAiLCJ1biI6IiIsInUiOiJodHRwczovL3ByZWJvcm4uYmFieS9BRUwwOTIzRU1TMyJ9/SScEVDS7tdbkBbv7d6y0cg)
---
Friend, Last year we saved more than 53,452 babies and led 9,544 women to Christ!
Will you help to encourage a young mom at a crossroads to CHOOSE LIFE today? **_I truly believe that young moms facing unplanned pregnancies must be met with hope ... an offer of life ... and the opportunity to hear the Gospel of Jesus Christ._** At PreBorn!, we lead the nation in empowering women by offering compassionate, Christ-centered pregnancy and postpartum care. [**Will you do me a favor and sign a note of support to an expectant mother? My goal is to get 53,452 notes signed - one for every baby we saved in 2022 - to share with women who come into our 200+ PreBorn! Network Clinics.**](http://trk.faithandlibertymail.com/c/7/eyJhaSI6OTkyNjA2OTcsImUiOiJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSIsInJpIjoiMTM1MDI1NTcxMSIsInJxIjoiMDItYjIzMjU4LWYwOTYzZDA5NTQ4YTRkY2JhMGIxMjRjN2I0N2U3NjRkIiwicGgiOm51bGwsIm0iOmZhbHNlLCJ1aSI6IjEiLCJ1biI6IiIsInUiOiJodHRwczovL3ByZWJvcm4uYmFieS9BRUwwOTIzRU1TMyJ9/W-cGh69Rx6of5XOQkwcjDg)
---
[Sign a note of support to an expectant mom](http://trk.faithandlibertymail.com/c/7/eyJhaSI6OTkyNjA2OTcsImUiOiJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSIsInJpIjoiMTM1MDI1NTcxMSIsInJxIjoiMDItYjIzMjU4LWYwOTYzZDA5NTQ4YTRkY2JhMGIxMjRjN2I0N2U3NjRkIiwicGgiOm51bGwsIm0iOmZhbHNlLCJ1aSI6IjIiLCJ1biI6IiIsInUiOiJodHRwczovL3ByZWJvcm4uYmFieS9BRUwwOTIzRU1TMyJ9/HIgGsLAk5PZ2lil42qQl0Q)
---
**Abortion is the greatest humanitarian crisis of our generation.** One abortion occurs every minute in America, and more than 1,600 abortions occur every single day. Not content to watch lives created in His image destroyed, PreBorn! has boldly charged forward and grown from a fledgling non-profit to the nation's single largest pro-life organization in just a few years' time. And how did we do it? By God's grace, we have found a more effective way to "open our mouths for the mute" (Prov. 31:8). While the abortion debate rages in state legislatures and courtrooms, we take a different approach: leading the nation in empowering women facing unplanned pregnancies by offering compassionate, Christ-centered care. And we want to invite you to join us in that life-saving, eternity-impacting work. There is no greater joy than saving a preborn baby from abortion and giving a mom the opportunity to hear the Gospel of Jesus Christ. [**Please join PreBorn! today to send a note of support to a future mom at one of our PreBorn! Network Clinics. Your loving support and testimony of God's love can make the difference in a mom-to-be choosing life for her preborn child!**](http://trk.faithandlibertymail.com/c/7/eyJhaSI6OTkyNjA2OTcsImUiOiJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSIsInJpIjoiMTM1MDI1NTcxMSIsInJxIjoiMDItYjIzMjU4LWYwOTYzZDA5NTQ4YTRkY2JhMGIxMjRjN2I0N2U3NjRkIiwicGgiOm51bGwsIm0iOmZhbHNlLCJ1aSI6IjMiLCJ1biI6IiIsInUiOiJodHRwczovL3ByZWJvcm4uYmFieS9BRUwwOTIzRU1TMyJ9/MomTgpHKsnX6wgkop-Yp-w)
---
[Sign a note of support to an expectant mom](http://trk.faithandlibertymail.com/c/7/eyJhaSI6OTkyNjA2OTcsImUiOiJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSIsInJpIjoiMTM1MDI1NTcxMSIsInJxIjoiMDItYjIzMjU4LWYwOTYzZDA5NTQ4YTRkY2JhMGIxMjRjN2I0N2U3NjRkIiwicGgiOm51bGwsIm0iOmZhbHNlLCJ1aSI6IjQiLCJ1biI6IiIsInUiOiJodHRwczovL3ByZWJvcm4uYmFieS9BRUwwOTIzRU1TMyJ9/5HuQ5vdq_lDtplSARPZl4w)
---
All that PreBorn! does is motivated by a desire to see the Gospel of Jesus Christ transform the lives of mothers and their children. Our PreBorn! Network Clinics even receive an evangelism training program to equip them with the tools required to move beyond the fears and misconceptions of sharing the Gospel. **_We put an enormous emphasis on prayer, which, I believe, is the reason we lead the nation in the number of clinic visitors who come to know Jesus Christ as their Savior._** Prayer is powerful. Jesus hears us. [**Friend, your prayers and your love - shared through a note of support - will make a difference to a future mom at a crossroads today.**](http://trk.faithandlibertymail.com/c/7/eyJhaSI6OTkyNjA2OTcsImUiOiJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSIsInJpIjoiMTM1MDI1NTcxMSIsInJxIjoiMDItYjIzMjU4LWYwOTYzZDA5NTQ4YTRkY2JhMGIxMjRjN2I0N2U3NjRkIiwicGgiOm51bGwsIm0iOmZhbHNlLCJ1aSI6IjUiLCJ1biI6IiIsInUiOiJodHRwczovL3ByZWJvcm4uYmFieS9BRUwwOTIzRU1TMyJ9/2Njzl_InnO0z1iW5CM3Ffw) Please join us in praying for the thousands of moms-to-be and preborn babies who will find hope, love, and a bright future through PreBorn! and our PreBorn! Network Clinics. We praise God for His intervention on behalf of these women and their children -- to Him alone be the Glory! Choosing life, Dan SteinerPreBorn!

I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I’m running for President of the United States. I’m running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago – an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again. I’m running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something – that we do love this country. I’m running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I’m doing this for my son who’s a senior in college and shouldn’t have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn’t believe in just to get an A. I’m running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer. I’m running for President because we have a country to save! I’ve seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden’s leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better. I'm running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country.

I'm running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I'm running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer.

**As governor, I was dubbed a "jobs governor"** because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery.

I know how to make America strong and proud because I've done it before. **And I 'll do it as your next President. **

name: Harmeet Dhillon
subject: There are STILL Covid mandates
body:
Because after years of inconsistent, unscientific, and ineffective measures to “slow the spread” of COVID-19, the powers that be are trying to bring them back.

| |
---
| | Friend, I hope you’re paying attention.Because after years of inconsistent, unscientific, and ineffective measures to “slow the spread” of COVID-19, the powers that be are trying to bring them back. And we’re fighting to stop that from happening.**[But we need your urgent help in order to win. Will you help us stop more draconian COVID mandates with a tax-deductible donation of $35 or more today?](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z220f4sj05n8a54oek7ksfu81gopd52o66f924do_rp22sh2s8i66p71ctjmaor6c1h2bs)** Let me explain.**Last week we filed a lawsuit against the North Carolina Symphony on behalf of three musicians who were fired for refusing to get the COVID vaccine.** And if we can win this critical legal battle, we can put employers across the country on notice ahead of this so-called “COVID resurgence.” Dovid was the assistant concertmaster and first violinist, while Chris and Rachel both played the French Horn.These are some of the most talented musicians in the country that were in highly coveted and competitive positions._Each of them had been in the Symphony for over a decade._ When the Symphony introduced their COVID vaccine mandate, it offered both religious and medical exemptions.Dovid, Chris, and Rachel each held sincere religious beliefs that prohibited from taking the vaccine, and they all filed their exemptions and were willing to take other measures like regularly testing to prove they didn’t have COVID. But just a day after they submitted their exemptions, the Symphony rejected ALL of them and shortly thereafter put them on a year of UNPAID LEAVE.Just point illustrate how ridiculous the Symphony’s vaccine mandate really was—patrons, sitting mere feet away from musicians, didn’t have to be vaccinated, but our clients lost their jobs for not taking the vaccine. Even after the Symphony lifted its vaccine mandate, it refused to give these musicians their jobs back.We won’t take this attack on their freedoms lying down, because it’s an attack on your freedoms too.We all saw in the news recently that a public school in Maryland announce it is reinstating its mask mandate. And with _USA Today_ and others reporting the “rise” of COVID infection rates, Americans are rightfully concerned that COVID restrictions could be returning.We cannot allow the North Carolina Symphony to get away with firing musicians for refusing a COVID vaccine. **[That’s why I hope I can count on your generous donation of $35 or more right away to put an end to this while we still can.](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zg2av58ke6j5h5g2ce75u2a2mtv5f2q4qn74o49g_rp22sh2s8i66p71ctjmaor6c1h2bs)** Because of your support the Center for American Liberty has already had several victories against government agencies who have tried to enforce draconian COVID restrictions.In fact, we beat Gavin Newsom THREE TIMES at the Supreme Court of the United States.With you behind us, we’re not afraid to defend our liberties against anyone. **[Will you join the fight with a generous donation today and help us beat back unconstitutional COVID mandates one more time?](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zsit0dmdmv1kim7f3pin06r2c7ph3qcf65u4ft40_rp22sh2s8i66p71ctjmaor6c1h2bs)** Time is of the essence, and if you don’t take a stand, Friend, who will? Thank you in advance for your continued support.

subject: Hearing Aids Just Got Their Biggest Upgrade Yet...
body:
Let's be honest, very few people want to wear hearing aids.

| [ ](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c23693%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=KZJwfg53rjeh%2flMD5o2How&sysid=1)
---
| 2 Germans are crushing the market with these powerful hearing aids
---
[ ](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c23694%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=UZ0uDP5NnJNmIRf8VqmTzw&sysid=1)
Dr. Marco Vietor and Paul Crusius have been creating successful businesses since college. Now they lead [ hear.com](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c23605%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=ZFmOJjtWJ9LGRz11ldyXYA&sysid=1), the fastest growing hearing aid company in the world. This is their story.

Let's be honest, very few people want to wear hearing aids. Although there have been huge breakthroughs in technology, most people don't use them simply because they are still big and ugly. However, Dr. Marco Vietor and Paul Crusius wanted to change this perception with **a revolutionary device developed with top German hearing aid engineers** formerly from Siemens. After many years of research and development, this team of engineers came up with a game-changing hearing aid that's completely crushing the market with powerful German technology.

**The result:** A hearing device that packs cutting-edge technology in a design so small, it completely disappears inside the ear. It's called the Horizon Mini by [ hear.com](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c23605%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=ZFmOJjtWJ9LGRz11ldyXYA&sysid=1).
[ Check if you qualify ](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c23606%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=KLCFz6%2b7N89rI%2f1pxlJjZQ&sysid=1)
[ ](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c23694%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=UZ0uDP5NnJNmIRf8VqmTzw&sysid=1)
Horizon Mini comes with smartphone connectivity, allowing you to control the device with your iPhone or Android. In addition, this new device uses a unique algorithm that is clinically proven to deliver better than normal hearing. You will notice remarkable improvements in your ability to clearly understand speech, even in noisy environments like a busy restaurant.

Limited no-risk trials now available

It's really no surprise that this level of innovation is changing lives all over the world. People are experiencing the everyday benefits of this amazing device with [ hear.com](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c23605%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=ZFmOJjtWJ9LGRz11ldyXYA&sysid=1)'s **45-day no-risk trial.**
[ Check if you qualify ](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c23606%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=KLCFz6%2b7N89rI%2f1pxlJjZQ&sysid=1)

body:

No images? [Click here](https://news.huffinesliberty.com/t/t-e-vlthdhd-yuddtktydi-yh/) [](https://news.huffinesliberty.com/t/t-l-vlthdhd-yuddtktydi-r/) FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE
Contact: Noah Betz; 281-928-2089
[noah@bluestonecreatives.com](mailto:noah@bluestonecreatives.com) Hello patriots!This is Don Huffines. I wanted to share with you a few things that I have been up to this past week as I fight for liberty alongside you... **Huffines Argues Texas Hasn 't Gone Far Enough After Judge Orders Buoys Removed** [](https://news.huffinesliberty.com/t/t-l-vlthdhd-yuddtktydi-y/) "Article 1, Section 10 of the Constitution clearly gives the states the authority to do what they need to do to repel an invasion if the federal government is not coming to their aid," says Don Huffines, former state senator and president of the Huffines Liberty Foundation."Texas should have the strongest E-Verify laws in the nation, and we couldn't get it out of the Texas Senate," says Huffines. "Texas should make sure we don't give illegals in-state tuition, but I would go further than that and say we shouldn't even allow illegals to go to our state school system."[_Click here to watch my interview with KTRH 740 News Radio._](https://news.huffinesliberty.com/t/t-l-vlthdhd-yuddtktydi-j/) **Abbott Touts Misleading Tax Cuts** [](https://news.huffinesliberty.com/t/t-l-vlthdhd-yuddtktydi-t/) "Recently, Texas politicians took a victory lap as Gov. Greg Abbott signed what they claimed--at $18 billion--to be the "largest property tax cut in Texas history!" The problem with their boasting is that no one yet knows how much of a tax cut Texans will receive when they get their property tax bills this December.There is one thing we can be sure of, however. The property tax cut that Texans will get this year will be nowhere near $18 billion.At the Huffines Liberty Foundation, we estimate that total property tax revenue in 2023 will be approximately $80 billion. This means that the "largest property tax cut in history" touted by Gov. Abbott, Lt. Gov. Patrick, Speaker Dade Phelan, and others will not be $18 billion. Instead, it will be about $1.7 billion.Not only have Texas politicians intentionally misled us about how big our property tax cut will be this year, but they also did nothing to stop the future growth of property taxes."[_Click here to read my full op-ed in the Dallas Express._](https://news.huffinesliberty.com/t/t-l-vlthdhd-yuddtktydi-h/) **Don Huffines on The Kenny Webster Show** [](https://news.huffinesliberty.com/t/t-l-vlthdhd-yuddtktydi-k/) Kenny Webster and I discuss the threat of Texas turning blue.[_Click here to watch my interview with Kenny Webster._](https://news.huffinesliberty.com/t/t-l-vlthdhd-yuddtktydi-u/) May God bless you, your family, and the great state of Texas. Our greatest days are coming. See you on the battlefield!For Liberty, Prosperity, and Virtue Always, Don Huffines

I wanted to share with you a few things that I have been up to this past week as I fight for liberty alongside you... Huffines Argues Texas Hasn 't Gone Far Enough After Judge Orders Buoys Removed "Article 1, Section 10 of the Constitution clearly gives the states the authority to do what they need to do to repel an invasion if the federal government is not coming to their aid," says Don Huffines, former state senator and president of the Huffines Liberty Foundation."Texas should have the strongest E-Verify laws in the nation, and we couldn't get it out of the Texas Senate," says Huffines. "Texas should make sure we don't give illegals in-state tuition, but I would go further than that and say we shouldn't even allow illegals to go to our state school system." Abbott Touts Misleading Tax Cuts "Recently, Texas politicians took a victory lap as Gov. Greg Abbott signed what they claimed--at $18 billion--to be the "largest property tax cut in Texas history!" The problem with their boasting is that no one yet knows how much of a tax cut Texans will receive when they get their property tax bills this December.There is one thing we can be sure of, however. The property tax cut that Texans will get this year will be nowhere near $18 billion.At the Huffines Liberty Foundation, we estimate that total property tax revenue in 2023 will be approximately $80 billion. This means that the "largest property tax cut in history" touted by Gov. Abbott, Lt. Gov. Patrick, Speaker Dade Phelan, and others will not be $18 billion. Instead, it will be about $1.7 billion.Not only have Texas politicians intentionally misled us about how big our property tax cut will be this year, but they also did nothing to stop the future growth of property taxes." Don Huffines on The Kenny Webster Show Kenny Webster and I discuss the threat of Texas turning blue. May God bless you, your family, and the great state of Texas. Our greatest days are coming. ## Hunter Biden Indicted on Gun Charges
Hunter Biden was [indicted Thursday on federal gun charges](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFugzAYBp8GNkfmtw148NAlW7p2RMb-DH_lmAgcor59lc4dT7ec7us23TxnLsunv8PVtE0-VD4xSSs6I0hN1EaXAIJq4bre6mGwozXt6voOfVKUtKKgIjpShCRpHA2lniBbdiRJSdsZaY0hc5Ez2VmZOBvoYG3XaInIddsv3xuXuiLln-3Efgnbvc1urfVxNOqjoWtDV_8oeB1v9Ya9csho6Lo-S8UuZo4oYnkWEVa_LxBcThyVF195KwImjBHRSvgxEEUCYQiztKPU86CHdnfx8eKc-eiHRsvl7jn_ZdT_r_wGAAD__yHEYqs), two months after a plea deal that would have protected him from prosecution collapsed under a judge's questioning. Biden was charged by Special Counsel David Weiss with [lying about his drug use](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LFyhCAQgOGnwQ4HF9HbgiKN3aVN6SAsuhkOHOXO5O0zSZ36L_6Z7-M-3x0nzuu7e5CtsczOV37RrFB2RoKeoQk2EgHphmw3YD-OeEPTbPY24LBEHDGa4LEbwWtyA4aw9BqNGhu2oEAr7IxCY8C0agFctAmLod4jdqJXFLiWo_0snOtGMX2XFx2tL48m2a3W_RT6TcAkYLquq43lK9N1_nYB014SV_angGl75kqHXDhQlpwD-0pBliwjBTpckuszS7-5Y6XmsGG_OCU-h1H0an04Tn_H-j_ATwAAAP___fZeDQ) while buying a gun. The gun was found by police in 2018 after being thrown in a dumpster by Hallie Biden, his late brother Beau's widow. Biden's lawyers vowed a vigorous constitutional defense. Court rulings have differed on the 2nd amendment implications of barring protected gun ownership because of drug use. ([Read the Indictment](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsz7GO8yAQBOCnwR0WLGCyBcUv_XKXa6-0sHdJ9kRClKBY9_YnX33TfiON5vO8nLNUuV8-8o1TL23JW5c3Lwa1DRrcAgOlwgzsBk52Qh8jnjAM1xR9jswuwuQpbtlHZ6mQN0CnMrmCgyQw4AzaYDAECKNZAVcXaA3sN0SrvGGS3p7jV5N7v3Kp3-3Nz3Frt6Gma--Pl3L_FMwK5n3fx0er0mVrR0HBXA5xs5By_80Re8oaPVlNFFjntbDGQi5kCwcPz0SPXWqV1xSVN5dblvo71v_-_hMAAP__hmhWiA))
## Vegas Casinos Crippled by Hackers
Hackers [targeting Las Vegas casinos](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskD1vwyAQQH8N3hzhA-LcwNCFLV07WnAcMa0_InxNlX9fpXPnJ70nvY_rdI11qdvtPa7spexTJKkPnjT2g-vBTNBlX5iBTcd-OKMdR7yg62ZfEmU8Jw3OmITWGNLFZryUIZUMjrvqQYPRODiNzoE76QSYjMvJsSXEQVnNucreTp973WTmsjz3B7cT7Wu3-FnkfijzpiAoCMI0U_veaH5hBeElVxA0KgiDVRAo8hHb0fMm3CTWbeVN-hwl9qlxpLmnZ-IWRSJ9KQhd8_n-U5elHudRWX1bY13-2vL_it8AAAD__whQX10) have created five days of chaos at MGM Resorts' hotels and stolen the loyalty program database from Caesar's Entertainment, including driver's licenses and social security numbers. Casesar's acknowledged its attack in a filing Thursday with the SEC. They said they were hit by a ["social engineering attack,"](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFurDAQAL_GdEZmjQEXFK-hu9emRGuzHJuAfcKrI_f30aVOPdJoNB-3-Ya8c7r_x4NGWfOMUfhJs_G6cRrsDNUyrkRAtqKx6Xzb937wrtpGY0NAMH3ooV1pWZqweDtYY4a-g37oKh7BgDW-ccY7B642AXywbgmO2uh9o1pDC0s-68_MSTZa91d-0lnHfFT7uIk8irL_FEwKpuu6avzmXN5UwfR2K5iMVzA1rYIpIhU8i6YkdApyOiiJ5qJ3FCqiIxZOWccNOWnJOua08nloFn1h0RuLDi-NOr4CnSiC8as6x-Vx8b5z6XrVmvuBvP_Wyd-zfgIAAP__Iq1rgw) meaning a hacker convinced a person to give them access and said the cost to them was still unknown. MGM Resorts had many of its operations shut down by hackers, including ATM and slot machines as well as [the check-in system and even digital keys](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskL1utDAQAJ_GdEbL2gZcuPg-RXSXNiXyzwJOAJ9s5068fXSpU08zMx-3-WbjHs_13R5k6pJm62t80Ayad4qjmLEJZiFCEg2ZrtdyGPSoVbOZAC5oCFqOvXRCeRhEDw7c0A9I1LkmGgQUoDsFWilULTjUTqjgFEmvdcckUIg15fYzxbNutOxXelBufTqa3Wy13gsT_xhODCfr_EnP0q7phRlO_79LPKkUhtOxHjwTvUK4vxxl7jebClc82Ktwu1TK3NZq_RfDqdSULyamGJh460B0chxBN9mE-zPueyz9wCSsh437r0n9e8xPAAAA__9P1WNw) to guest rooms. It's not clear if the attacks were by the same group.
## Trump to Appear on 'Meet the Press' Sunday
Donald Trump will give [his first broadcast network interview](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskL1y8yAQAJ9G6vAchxBcQfE17vy1KTUIDpsY_Qwi1uTtM06dcmebnf24TTefS17v__3CrqVt8qHlF09AQmqBasI-usSMrHp2cqTBGLKk-4cbNSSkqHwACRxsQgsDWgIpISCbPjsEVEBSA2mN-gIz0qx0nDUPgUh2A3DMbauXzy2v7cGpfG8vrpewLX1xj9b2o1P_Orx2ePX7yufxVm-oLYfCHV5b_Vp28az5aLyKk8uTq1iYm9grH4dY5yAsKA6WyKSoxqDQWAbkNCozzN6Psa8u7mcuJR-j6Qa4Lz6X34j295OfAAAA___88WFI) since leaving office with Kristin Walker on "Meet the Press" this Sunday. The interview will be pre-taped at Trump's New Jersey golf club. It will be Welker's first week hosting the show. |
Fellow American,

America was born from a revolution.

The creation of our nation didn't happen from moderate, incremental change. It happened through radical change. That's why I am unveiling my plan to SHUT DOWN the Administrative, Deep State.

[](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=c085c1c1600648b0a5626f1e9e9b6463&_e=PgR3jHRRDSakb5PImYTykS1kRm9W6rqxYWNY7Q9rYp0s_ueIrE_279w2yZLt4zhi_wNMZ3U4qPtBI99fCO5jMr4sr95U6lKtVn5cCug_H62vxVwS0qfl-mAtJjZ7X3IC6U3UDpDq5RPHHtyuSxSITFs1qfeKMn6Q9It0idNydvjFSQdBaHae7ULxCAtCsl-SABrKnqrTcH2uv_P9aNl91lFBnH9wjrjpnqz0NRfDh9-6Us-xe2idprOJOfDC7NCN8yKCMiHKG40_g8ADYUgZ_qJtkCHarR1l6baTm81pnu6cDVz4NJAo6rtbtZlwDioxuoYlLGhdimqzJ3Bj407vub8f5mKHvc8x7zQnjjRv3MvYHUstITGtFarDcHQDyPvbcglHX3YtSD7rvEhms028MKFaU0C3HIyli4AvMS9BYpQ%3D)
Here's something I've learned as a CEO. If someone works for you and you cannot fire them - they don't work for you, **YOU** work for _them_.

We must shut down the fourth branch of government. They don't have the same political oversight as Members of Congress or the President. You cannot fire them on Election Day. That's why we need a system of checks and balances when it comes to the administrative state.

**[Will you join me in my plan in shutting down the administrative state?](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=c085c1c1600648b0a5626f1e9e9b6463&_e=PgR3jHRRDSakb5PImYTykS1kRm9W6rqxYWNY7Q9rYp0s_ueIrE_279w2yZLt4zhi_wNMZ3U4qPtBI99fCO5jMr4sr95U6lKtVn5cCug_H62vxVwS0qfl-mAtJjZ7X3IC6U3UDpDq5RPHHtyuSxSITFs1qfeKMn6Q9It0idNydvjFSQdBaHae7ULxCAtCsl-SABrKnqrTcH2uv_P9aNl91lFBnH9wjrjpnqz0NRfDh9-6Us-xe2idprOJOfDC7NCN92C_jSd4HqyTuutfDbTuWJtWeEbSsc8eSIEhI2b7dme_pIKFQLoDx6v8e3REe5-XGm2KH3QLTiJa7thn1GmZ32cx3FLEOg_Sy3W-xF1Ile6wmORyoFWfMiRo-LA5pfZRG3lu5EiNbs5njcc0m84ht_AUMcUDGRzhTidPXVeNlpg%3D)**

**[Shut down the Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI)](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=c085c1c1600648b0a5626f1e9e9b6463&_e=PgR3jHRRDSakb5PImYTykS1kRm9W6rqxYWNY7Q9rYp0s_ueIrE_279w2yZLt4zhi_wNMZ3U4qPtBI99fCO5jMr4sr95U6lKtVn5cCug_H62vxVwS0qfl-mAtJjZ7X3IC6U3UDpDq5RPHHtyuSxSITFs1qfeKMn6Q9It0idNydvjFSQdBaHae7ULxCAtCsl-SABrKnqrTcH2uv_P9aNl91lFBnH9wjrjpnqz0NRfDh9-6Us-xe2idprOJOfDC7NCNKDSTsA5JIGFn2jraSMEnCte7C5xzWlwh5xWox7G1iYkFO22oGp2RQLayieMc-eQzQrZ0gjBm5oPyzvMY81XlK5WrkncXG62CBckRf7VWdaTORys9MnfmR6-YhR0FFoOIu_A6zqcDticJePN9wVXC6W9cbRYKIjiFhUToWHmp8hI%3D)**
**[Shut down the Department of Education (DoEd)](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=c085c1c1600648b0a5626f1e9e9b6463&_e=PgR3jHRRDSakb5PImYTykS1kRm9W6rqxYWNY7Q9rYp0s_ueIrE_279w2yZLt4zhi_wNMZ3U4qPtBI99fCO5jMr4sr95U6lKtVn5cCug_H62vxVwS0qfl-mAtJjZ7X3IC6U3UDpDq5RPHHtyuSxSITFs1qfeKMn6Q9It0idNydvjFSQdBaHae7ULxCAtCsl-SABrKnqrTcH2uv_P9aNl91lFBnH9wjrjpnqz0NRfDh9-6Us-xe2idprOJOfDC7NCNnjl-hnUkVSk3KCW1TrcYVCvl59z20tCA-kywkcZ2kXy2wvonn00lHrmAfvgEbHOhx0C8sW2EvdKBTopo_dXQsbx8r8vNkFdNp9npFZO8IQbpi0X5xFtwyy-QszCCLAx_6Ybm5WX8UCgdCNq9rodzV7b9b4tYfbQ0j5cJijcLgV8%3D)**

**[Shut down the Food and Nutrition Services (FNS)](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=c085c1c1600648b0a5626f1e9e9b6463&_e=PgR3jHRRDSakb5PImYTykS1kRm9W6rqxYWNY7Q9rYp0s_ueIrE_279w2yZLt4zhi_wNMZ3U4qPtBI99fCO5jMr4sr95U6lKtVn5cCug_H62vxVwS0qfl-mAtJjZ7X3IC6U3UDpDq5RPHHtyuSxSITFs1qfeKMn6Q9It0idNydvjFSQdBaHae7ULxCAtCsl-SABrKnqrTcH2uv_P9aNl91lFBnH9wjrjpnqz0NRfDh9-6Us-xe2idprOJOfDC7NCNKNWxkIIiQjqgTX5vdSNh-8-vPLDv-kKDAELP0AMsWk1j5EqgDvDOAKgISEddoaNLIDlVlYVB3dfnycrriW6n1J1sAU_IIeglhjvyxf2IrhqgY1TBXfCNJsQISpa3q_lTjTPho2cJ4dYofy8X5-uEJ_03E7ibgPF-VYVsIRrhQrY%3D)**
Bureaucracy is a formula for corruption. **[It's time to end the weaponization of the fourth branch of government in America once and for all.](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=c085c1c1600648b0a5626f1e9e9b6463&_e=PgR3jHRRDSakb5PImYTykS1kRm9W6rqxYWNY7Q9rYp0s_ueIrE_279w2yZLt4zhi_wNMZ3U4qPtBI99fCO5jMr4sr95U6lKtVn5cCug_H62vxVwS0qfl-mAtJjZ7X3IC6U3UDpDq5RPHHtyuSxSITFs1qfeKMn6Q9It0idNydvjFSQdBaHae7ULxCAtCsl-SABrKnqrTcH2uv_P9aNl91lFBnH9wjrjpnqz0NRfDh9-6Us-xe2idprOJOfDC7NCNyjmHJNjDU8VwXdET4N7PLsGvBXCiBD8YRXTs1MuEUeEd99NDZl67BSr6Q-PZxeLPL-D87T3t2sCJdQrNDOWtU9qID8Dp4u8yGeMiyZ6KaayilDAQ8_5aZG_U-ZgsgkCV7hn82OVn9v7djLJJsYj1Fjdi0IZOLT81HByPxOGRMhs%3D)**

Most Republicans favor reform. I favor revolution.

Any politician who says they're going to "fix" the deep state is delusional. The administrative state is unconstitutional. The right answer: *shut it down.* You can't tame the Leviathan - you have to slay it.

Here's the TRUTH: **If you strike the swamp,_the swamp strikes back._ **

name: Desiree Crespo
subject: My brother is rotting in prison for doing his job
body:
I'm writing to you now, heartbroken, because my brother cannot.

| |
---
| | Dear Friend, I'm writing to you now, heartbroken, because my brother cannot. Right now, my little brother Jovanny Crespo is sitting in a cold prison like a caged animal. He can't go outside and enjoy the sun and fresh air like you and me. His young children aren't even allowed to visit him. Jovanny is utterly alone... ...all because he showed up to work one day and followed his training. Because, you see, Jovanny was a police officer who has been unjustly convicted of manslaughter after a split-second, life or death decision in the line of duty. Back in January 2019, Jovanny and his partner got a call on their dispatch radio to help stop an armed suspect who was trying to evade police. After chasing the suspects for a few miles, they were finally able to cut the fleeing suspects off. That's when my brother's life flashed before his eyes. When he got out of the police cruiser and rushed to the suspects' car to make the arrest... ... **he saw the passenger pointing a gun right at him**. Friend, Jovanny literally had seconds to make a decision if he wanted to live. So, he fired at the gun-wielding criminal - **stopping the threat to his life, the lives of his fellow officers, and the entire community.** It was a clear-cut case of self-defense. And he protected his partner and his community from a dangerous criminal -- exactly what he was trained to do. **So, you can imagine my shock when I found out Jovanny was being prosecuted for a crime instead of awarded for his bravery.** I always knew the dangers of his job. I worried about him all the time - he's still my baby brother, after all. I used to lie awake at night worrying about whether he'd be injured or killed in the line of duty. As you may know, it's a difficult and dangerous time to be in law enforcement. Officers across America have targets on their back just for wearing the uniform. And friend, if you've never been to Newark, let me assure you, Jovanny was working in one of the roughest neighborhoods in New Jersey. Many nights he would call me or one of our brothers if he thought he was going to be mugged...because he had been before. Most of the vocally anti-law enforcement politicians and prosecutors in our country wouldn't dare to even walk through a neighborhood like the one my brother lived and worked in daily. But still, he did his job every single day out of love for his community and a sense of duty. So I was stunned and horrified when I learned that he was facing life in prison, something I had never even thought to fear. **You never think something like this will happen to you** ...until it does, and you're left reeling from the shock. But I didn't have long to process these unjust charges. I had to stay focused on the biggest problem my family was facing: _how are we going to pay for Jovanny's defense?_ A case like this can cost hundreds of thousands of dollars - that's money that we just can't scrape together. The answer to our prayers finally came when we received a call from Jason Johnson, president of Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund, who had heard about Jovanny's case. LELDF defends good officers, like my brother, who have been unfairly prosecuted for split-second, use-of-force decisions in the line of duty. They have generously helped us pay for Jovanny's legal defense and have been standing with us every step of the way for years when other organizations turned their backs on us. Now that my brother has been convicted, they're committing to raising money for his appeal, but that will require more hours of legal research, legal motions, and court hearings than we had ever planned for. To be honest, Friend, I'm not used to asking for help. But today I'm going to take a deep breath and ask you one of the hardest questions I've ever asked another person: **[Will you help LELDF fight for my brother Jovanny by making a tax-deductible donation of any amount today?](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=4cdb000243584cfb87ae8cd5c0ce15d3&_e=gOu7CkeToKe2kDt8avvxL5O19FBBmZZ-nQ8wMgw5t1z5bpGutLNeAAUw8sdD0hZfT7BV4Nig8LpmIn-eZADM2CHeYSfyZ3b7BEIxKPefrUkuxJpUl1Pgwvh-oFEfVPlZl056qFCGMit09dNnqxvDQauHqatdw1dv9nRsCzZZtIL6Zo8s_8augn-hU1c7am6PoJJcdtbcf444nUtzPludvSjCjIwE73ztcajmdEVehEddHrMmPFA3BsKgL8EM_sAM2TVZccmtVqK7_4VR7Nj3Go2xJLvKHT7aqZFH1yb5l2APcMkq1zDHpL0v6jNOZjLfSflgPtzeYER2-kr3CAFMvHNQJHAZ4rtX4x71CafnDWtv700inFjOjaPbbOauDKKd)** The thing you have to know about my brother is that he is the gentlest person you'll ever meet -- not the aggressive monster the media wants you to think he is. Before his conviction, he spent his free time coaching youth baseball in the city he grew up in and loves. He's been through so much in his life, but he's taken every trial and turned it into motivation to be better and to help those around him... that's why he became an officer in the first place. **And nothing matters to Jovanny more than his own four children.** Jovanny's greatest desire create a life for his kids that he never had himself, and he'll do anything he can to provide for them. **[So I hope and pray you'll send a gift of $30, or any amount you can spare, to help get Jovanny out of prison and back where he belongs, with his children.](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=4cdb000243584cfb87ae8cd5c0ce15d3&_e=gOu7CkeToKe2kDt8avvxL5O19FBBmZZ-nQ8wMgw5t1z5bpGutLNeAAUw8sdD0hZfT7BV4Nig8LpmIn-eZADM2CHeYSfyZ3b7BEIxKPefrUkuxJpUl1Pgwvh-oFEfVPlZl056qFCGMit09dNnqxvDQauHqatdw1dv9nRsCzZZtIL6Zo8s_8augn-hU1c7am6PoJJcdtbcf444nUtzPludvYwydUjnTUtpZNxyCBQ53YO4_IyY1VaCbVQLDwX4FHrWkFqJygFN5RnT0pb-rThsj2WsVsFmE5EAHMBaUVIH8fG77U2XwbYa7Dno46HZU-F9rQ0tYREXDetH7w5Q0oFuRBAfHgY0KqKxN_sfsKlvAuhBHqlRM7vU5CETgPdky9L8)** My friend, I know we've never met. But I hope you'll find it in your heart to help LELDF fight for my brother. **[Whether you can give $10, $30, or $100,](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=4cdb000243584cfb87ae8cd5c0ce15d3&_e=gOu7CkeToKe2kDt8avvxL5O19FBBmZZ-nQ8wMgw5t1z5bpGutLNeAAUw8sdD0hZfT7BV4Nig8LpmIn-eZADM2CHeYSfyZ3b7BEIxKPefrUkuxJpUl1Pgwvh-oFEfVPlZl056qFCGMit09dNnqxvDQauHqatdw1dv9nRsCzZZtIL6Zo8s_8augn-hU1c7am6PoJJcdtbcf444nUtzPludvX-DbbBTSRfy5eKxzFRKsqWCbS8ZIhTu9qm437iV-fpvsJzA524NiKzh6KwvkTy71JcLNyQo4CifyaWBaPhFO5PiFk7SYyw4O9F07Rpg50aMB5k-i1Rm8Pu6UG8Ygbqi6u-jUAueBjd2v02d8zaPGxSDGx2u-hrwyDlKkuyN2hRF)** your contribution could be the difference between letting Jovanny rot in prison for the rest of his life for a crime he didn't commit... or keeping him at home with his children where he belongs. After the hell we've been through, my family will be forever grateful for your contribution and support. I was able to speak to Jovanny recently and he wanted me to let everyone who has donated to his defense know how much it means to him and to our whole family - truly, he is not standing alone. So friend, thank you in advance for your kind support. People like you remind me that there is still good in this broken world. May God bless you.
---
| | Gratefully,
---
Desiree Crespo

clean_body: I'm writing to you now, heartbroken, because my brother cannot. | | | | Dear Friend, I'm writing to you now, heartbroken, because my brother cannot. Right now, my little brother Jovanny Crespo is sitting in a cold prison like a caged animal. He can't go outside and enjoy the sun and fresh air like you and me. His young children aren't even allowed to visit him. Jovanny is utterly alone... ...all because he showed up to work one day and followed his training. Because, you see, Jovanny was a police officer who has been unjustly convicted of manslaughter after a split-second, life or death decision in the line of duty. Back in January 2019, Jovanny and his partner got a call on their dispatch radio to help stop an armed suspect who was trying to evade police. After chasing the suspects for a few miles, they were finally able to cut the fleeing suspects off. That's when my brother's life flashed before his eyes. When he got out of the police cruiser and rushed to the suspects' car to make the arrest... ... he saw the passenger pointing a gun right at him. Friend, Jovanny literally had seconds to make a decision if he wanted to live. So, he fired at the gun-wielding criminal - stopping the threat to his life, the lives of his fellow officers, and the entire community. It was a clear-cut case of self-defense. And he protected his partner and his community from a dangerous criminal -- exactly what he was trained to do. So, you can imagine my shock when I found out Jovanny was being prosecuted for a crime instead of awarded for his bravery. I always knew the dangers of his job. I worried about him all the time - he's still my baby brother, after all. I used to lie awake at night worrying about whether he'd be injured or killed in the line of duty. As you may know, it's a difficult and dangerous time to be in law enforcement. Officers across America have targets on their back just for wearing the uniform. And friend, if you've never been to Newark, let me assure you, Jovanny was working in one of the roughest neighborhoods in New Jersey. Many nights he would call me or one of our brothers if he thought he was going to be mugged...because he had been before. Most of the vocally anti-law enforcement politicians and prosecutors in our country wouldn't dare to even walk through a neighborhood like the one my brother lived and worked in daily. But still, he did his job every single day out of love for his community and a sense of duty. So I was stunned and horrified when I learned that he was facing life in prison, something I had never even thought to fear. You never think something like this will happen to you ...until it does, and you're left reeling from the shock. But I didn't have long to process these unjust charges. I had to stay focused on the biggest problem my family was facing: how are we going to pay for Jovanny's defense? A case like this can cost hundreds of thousands of dollars - that's money that we just can't scrape together. The answer to our prayers finally came when we received a call from Jason Johnson, president of Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund, who had heard about Jovanny's case. LELDF defends good officers, like my brother, who have been unfairly prosecuted for split-second, use-of-force decisions in the line of duty. They have generously helped us pay for Jovanny's legal defense and have been standing with us every step of the way for years when other organizations turned their backs on us. Now that my brother has been convicted, they're committing to raising money for his appeal, but that will require more hours of legal research, legal motions, and court hearings than we had ever planned for. To be honest, Friend, I'm not used to asking for help. But today I'm going to take a deep breath and ask you one of the hardest questions I've ever asked another person: The thing you have to know about my brother is that he is the gentlest person you'll ever meet -- not the aggressive monster the media wants you to think he is. Before his conviction, he spent his free time coaching youth baseball in the city he grew up in and loves. He's been through so much in his life, but he's taken every trial and turned it into motivation to be better and to help those around him... that's why he became an officer in the first place. And nothing matters to Jovanny more than his own four children. Jovanny's greatest desire create a life for his kids that he never had himself, and he'll do anything he can to provide for them. My friend, I know we've never met. But I hope you'll find it in your heart to help LELDF fight for my brother. your contribution could be the difference between letting Jovanny rot in prison for the rest of his life for a crime he didn't commit... or keeping him at home with his children where he belongs. After the hell we've been through, my family will be forever grateful for your contribution and support. I was able to speak to Jovanny recently and he wanted me to let everyone who has donated to his defense know how much it means to him and to our whole family - truly, he is not standing alone. So friend, thank you in advance for your kind support. People like you remind me that there is still good in this broken world. May God bless you. | | Gratefully, Desiree Crespo P.S. My brother, Officer Jovanny Crespo, has been unjustly convicted of manslaughter is facing life in prison for a crime he didn't commit. Thank you in advance for your kind support. | | More such officers who sacrifice so much for will face similar fates unless we speak out and stand up for the brave men and women in blue. **Last year, approximately ONE-SIXTH of Florida’s manatee population was DECIMATED. Worse, an official report from the Florida Fish and Wildlife Commission confirms that at least 403 manatees have already perished in 2023! These gentle sea cows are dying at an alarming rate, and toxic pollution from the cruise industry contributes to this tragedy.**
**Why are manatee deaths spiking? They’re suffering from painful starvation because the seagrass they depend on is being destroyed by pollution-fed algae blooms and rising ocean temperatures. And mega-polluting industries like Big Cruise are worsening this problem every day.**
When cruise ships sail close to shore, they **disturb manatees' fragile habitat, churn up sand and sedimented pollution and are allowed to dump massive quantities of filthy, contaminated wastewater into their feeding grounds. Even worse, cruise ships emit TONS of CO2 into our atmosphere which leads to warmer ocean waters and seagrass death! That means manatees are being left to choke to death from lack of oxygen and wither away from starvation.** And unless we act to stop cruise companies from destroying their habitat, manatee populations could drop to the brink of EXTINCTION – fast.
These sweet, slow-moving manatees don’t deserve to suffer and die like this, friend. We can still protect them before it’s too late, but we need more people with us to take on Big Cruise and stop toxic pollution in our oceans and waterways.

Pro-Life Advocate,

I'm writing to you today as a passionate protector of vulnerable women and the unborn. I know that you share my belief that every human life is precious and should be protected.

I've been a pro-life activist for over 20 years, and I've seen firsthand the devastating effects of abortion on women, children, and families. I've met women who have had abortions and dealt with the pain and regret as they navigate a deeply felt loss in their lives. I've met children who were born after their mothers were denied an abortion and who are now thriving. And I've met families who have been torn apart by abortion.

I know that you're also aware of the recent Supreme Court decision to overturn Roe v. Wade. This is a historic victory for the pro-life movement, but this was just the beginning of the fight. **_We still have a long way to go to ensure that all unborn babies and their mothers are protected from abortion._**

The first step is for pro-life Americans to come together and state what we believe and what we will do in order to protect the unborn. [Will you join me in standing up for the rights of unborn children?](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=0c066ab9dca648efa56a801245815052&_e=2bQh_n66kqMw14zYlAncCQ6LEicBmv2pngkLn_oky5V-O_URW1dVQLVXiEZ8UOuaduuUlnqKU_mACjCpmP68d6BuM12lg6d__sQ73-CXz0DAqtlSfQbnpF964zNVSq6vE7QVBTDFujyaveLEbY2DYqMrtk7nLSHBSHetjvUfGPEZ-HXBB5LPTTGBOLfeZBTUYkQDI7LU3jJKAmektALGnTHksdB_Siu9ksXyC6IPSwr942pLFeWA_3OLx7OfnQG02_dJzC6EUjfXsaFeIlNw1GTCoGC6rmSRBn6AE99dpWSouSfLr0jggK-I4ESGXrh083OhnbnLYh4p-lR0Rw3-hALtm8Rtv1PDc3VyAEFJ4O1eSGul6gffjqO1Q2bAeQQYaGlu10dVrn94HUsRYyXa-w%3D%3D)

When you sign the pledge, you'll be joining a growing movement of pro-life Americans who are working to make a difference. You'll also be receiving regular updates from SBA Pro-Life America about the latest pro-life news and events.
[SIGN THE PLEDGE »](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=0c066ab9dca648efa56a801245815052&_e=2bQh_n66kqMw14zYlAncCQ6LEicBmv2pngkLn_oky5V-O_URW1dVQLVXiEZ8UOuaduuUlnqKU_mACjCpmP68d6BuM12lg6d__sQ73-CXz0DAqtlSfQbnpF964zNVSq6vE7QVBTDFujyaveLEbY2DYqMrtk7nLSHBSHetjvUfGPEZ-HXBB5LPTTGBOLfeZBTUYkQDI7LU3jJKAmektALGnTHksdB_Siu9ksXyC6IPSwr942pLFeWA_3OLx7OfnQG0um_vekPrSrW3lhRb3gNCLmK68WJcXtPAT4VYhTBN-VBHjwXxiPu4EQsJK9hD0uxbaQbzACJFOmIUPI1sJZkjR49G1qss8aDyl3XI5c0L0wOXBg7s2fO-l0KCYm69p-LILlu3HVpZX2kO-ANLBz7j5A%3D%3D)

I hope you'll join me in signing the SBA Pro-Life America Pledge to Stand Up for the Unborn. Together, we can build a pro-life America where every child is welcomed and valued.**

Today, the Crouch for Governor campaign released a campaign advertisement (https://vimeo.com/864145633?share=copy&utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=5d9f165aef-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_09_12_06_56_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-65daf18f47-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) detailing Suzanne’s proposal to eliminate Indiana’s individual income tax.

“Bidenomics is draining the hopes and savings of Hoosier families,” said Suzanne Crouch. “Combatting high inflation, interest rates, and harmful Washington, D.C. policies requires bold leadership right here in Indiana.”

Crouch’s “Axe the Tax” plan (https://crouchforindiana.com/axe-the-tax/?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=5d9f165aef-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_09_12_06_56_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-65daf18f47-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) would allow the average Hoosier family to keep nearly $2,000 of their own money.

“Indiana has a budget surplus of nearly $3 billion,” continued Crouch. “We need to stop taking so much of your money, reform government, and remain competitive for jobs, talent, and economic growth.”

Join the fight to "Axe the Tax" by visiting axethetaxindiana.com.

Kat Cammack, the youngest Republican woman in Congress. She won the seat on a conservative platform of growing jobs, securing our southern border, standing up for law enforcement, defending our Second Amendment, promoting fiscal responsibility, and defending life.
Congresswoman Cammack, now in her second term, sits on the House Committee on Energy and Commerce and House Committee on Agriculture, where she is the only Florida Republican serving the Sunshine State's farmers, ranchers, and producers. She was also appointed to the Select Subcommittee on the Weaponization of the Federal Government.
Kat and her husband Matt, who is a firefighter, paramedic, and SWAT medic, proudly call Gainesville, Florida home.

Good morning, Peter. I'm about to head into the first meeting of the day – but before I do, I wanted to send top supporters a quick message about what I'm fighting for in the Senate.

**One thing you should know about me is this:** Back when I was a kid, my dad – a World War II veteran and a Purple Heart recipient – got really sick and had to quit his job. Veteran benefits, food stamps and workforce programs helped my family of nine get back on our feet during a difficult few months.

**Looking back on that tough time, I'm so glad our country told my family, "We've got your back," instead of saying, "You're on your own." **Now, I'm fighting every day in the U.S. Senate to make sure working families have that same support – by making the expanded Child Tax Credit permanent, guaranteeing paid family leave, making child care affordable and easy to find, protecting reproductive rights, and so much more.
I promise to keep fighting for a strong economy that works for _everyone, _but to continue this important work, I need your help to defend our narrow Democratic Senate majority. **Politico is already reporting this year's map is "hell" for Democrats, so I need to reach my $50,000 mid-month goal before today at midnight to keep the Senate blue.**
**If you're ready to join my fight for working families, will you donate $5 today to help me reach my mid-month goal?**

Here's the best link to give: **[https://secure.actblue.com/contribute/page/pm-email-2023-q3/dpwillis67@gmail.com](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/69767280/427228954/657691562?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk132-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDM4NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3NWQxN2Q3ZS1jODUzLWVlMTEtOTkzNy0wMDIyNDgzMmU4MTEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=r81YoTXHpf68eAJOE9YMMa_rcOiVfe07ubTezmfBQcI=)**

Patty Murray

body:
https://www.facebook.com/TNVoterProject [https://www.facebook.com/TNVoterProject]
September 15, 2023
Dear Friend,
Early voting in Memphis starts TODAY, September 15! You'll be voting for the next City Mayor and City Council members. We're excited to share our final endorsement for Memphis Municipal elections.
Tennessee Voter Project is proud to endorse Van D. Turner, Jr. for Mayor of Memphis.
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP31/1/94287/images/TVP%20Endorsement%20Banner%20Van.png]
Van is undoubtably the progressive in this race. We're proud to join labor & various organizations and leaders throughout the city to endorse the candidate who has consistently put everyday Memphians over special interests.
He stood with Memphians in the fight to remove confederate statues from our public parks. He has a track record of not only standing with workers at the picket lines but advocating for living wages and better working conditions. He's prioritized our youth and their success by supporting funding so more kids could have access to Pre-K.
He has a history of community and public service as a Former County Commissioner and President of the Memphis Chapter of NAACP. We're confident he'll continue to serve the public interest as Mayor of Memphis.
Learn more about Van at www.vanformemphis.com [https://www.vanformemphis.com/] .
SUPPORT TENNESSEE VOTER PROJECT [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tvpaug17_1]
Skip the lines and early vote TODAY through September 30th. You can vote at any of these locations [https://www.electionsshelbytn.gov/sites/default/files/documents/EV%20Locations%20Oct%205%202023%20%282%29.pdf] . Early voting polls' opening and closing times vary so please check the link above for times. Election day is October 5.
You can see all of TVP's endorsed candidates here [https://www.tennesseevoterproject.com/901endorsements] . We hope you'll consider voting for our endorsed candidates to ensure Memphis continues on its trajectory toward progressive values that work for all of us.
Thanks for your support,
Tennessee Voter Project Staff

clean_body: a major step forward | | | BREAKING FROM POLITICO: Biden administration proposes to close loophole on background checks Friend: President Biden, Sen. Gillibrand, and other Democratic leaders are fighting to expand background checks and protect communities nationwide from gun violence. But they need grassroots activists like you to stand with them. | | Friend, America is in the midst of a gun violence epidemic. There have been nearly 500 mass shootings in 2023 alone. Our children and communities are living in fear of gun assailants and violence every day. But it doesn't have to be this way. There are simple gun safety reforms that we know will curb gun violence and make our communities safer. The vast majority of Americans support basic reforms like expanded background checks. Gun safety legislation shouldn't be a partisan issue. It's about protecting communities and preventing senseless deaths. But the far-right gun lobby is spending MILLIONS each year to stop common sense legislation from becoming the law of the land. And each year, the cycle of mass shooting and violence continues. That's why Democrats are fighting to finally make a change and pass universal background checks! This would be a major step forward to a safer future — and we're counting on grassroots activists like you to join these Democratic leaders in standing up to the gun lobby. | | | * | = A note from Kirsten: Friend, I can’t thank you enough for standing by my side in the critical fights ahead of us. As Democrats face our toughest Senate map in decades, I need your help more than ever. While Republicans only have to defend 10 seats in 2024, Democrats have to defend 23 – and if the GOP flips just two of them, it will deliver Senate control back to Mitch McConnell. Now, experts at FiveThirtyEight are saying that the GOP has a clear path to the majority. As right-wing special interests gear up to pour millions into flipping the Senate, we need to fight back right now. But I refuse to take a single cent from corporate PACs, which means I’m relying on your grassroots support. = And if you’d like to become a core member of my team and receive exclusive texts from my campaign, = Thank you, Kirsten Gillibrand

body:
More Americans have died from gun violence in my lifetime than in every single war in our nation’s history combined.
#

Hi friends, it’s Cory Booker — U.S. Senator from New Jersey.
Today, I am reaching out on behalf of my friend Gabby Giffords to ask if you will [**make a contribution of $3 to GIFFORDS PAC before their mid-month fundraising deadline passes at midnight.**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-sep23.BeCgjV&refcode=em230915-1-30&t=1&akid=6537%2E3935704%2EQmKcos)
Please give me a moment to explain why this request is so important.
**More Americans have died from gun violence in my lifetime than in every single war in our nation’s history combined.**
The cost of gun violence is immeasurable. Every gunshot wound and every mass shooting leaves an indelible mark on our nation’s soul.
We must break the cycle of gun violence in our nation. This is why I am working hard in Washington--for New Jerseyans and all Americans--to implement legislation that would provide funding for evidence-based community violence intervention programs.
I am proud to work with my friends at GIFFORDS PAC to help make change like this possible. For the past ten years, they have been leading the fight to get common sense gun safety legislation passed at the local, state, and federal levels.
GIFFORDS has had my back during my elections. So today, as they approach their mid-month fundraising deadline, I’m hoping we can do the same for them.
[**So please, will you use this link to make a contribution to GIFFORDS PAC today?**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-sep23.BeCgjV&refcode=em230915-1-30&t=2&akid=6537%2E3935704%2EQmKcos)

Friend,
A new poll finds that 72% of Americans believe our country is doing poorly right now.
That truly makes me sad.
America is the greatest country in the world – and we should settle for NOTHING less than the BEST.
Our country is home to the greatest innovators, the hardest workers, the most creative minds, and the bravest pioneers who believe that nothing is impossible.
It’s an absolute disgrace that our nation is currently being led by a complete and utter clown who has spent his entire career selling out our citizens to enrich himself.
This is why I’ve been saying that if you are doing poorly right now – as so many Americans are – don’t even think about donating.
And I won’t stop saying it!
Even during these dark times, I urge you to NEVER lose hope in America!
We are a nation that declared its independence from the world’s biggest empire, won two world wars, and landed the first man on the moon. _Resilience is in our blood._
Very soon, your favorite President will be back in the White House to turn around this mess – and our country will come ROARING BACK like never before!

| Growing up, I was taught to respect family, the land, and guns. But our way of life is under attack. Thanks to multi-millionaire Governor Greg Gianforte, Montana is being overrun by outsiders and his millionaire buddies who are buying their second, third, and fourth homes. Meanwhile, real Montanans can’t even afford to live in our state! While I’m no career politician like Gianforte, I do have a record of standing up for my values. I stood up to politicians and big corporations who threatened our indigenous community’s sacred Badger Two Medicine. As a former executive for a major gun manufacturer, I’ve spoken up against the dangerous radicalization in the industry, while maintaining the importance of a strong 2nd amendment. I believe in Montana where we protect our rivers, public land, water, and the air we breathe. I believe all Montana kids deserve a quality education. I believe in personal freedoms, responsibility and opportunity for all Montanans. I’m running for Governor because as a ranch kid, I was taught that if you saw something that needed to be done, you just did it. And Peter – Montana is at a crossroads. It’s hard to believe but a second term for Gianforte would be even more disastrous than his first. In just one term he’s already pushed for a 20% property tax hike, limited our access to public lands, and threatened women’s privacy and freedom. A second term will see our public schools defunded and Montana turned into a playground for the rich. Do I need to go on? [Listen closely, Peter – this is going to be a competitive race, and there’s a LOT on the line. Unlike Gianforte, I don’t have a bunch of millionaire pals I can call up to donate to my campaign. I’m going to rely on grassroots donors like you. Will you chip in whatever you’re able right now to my campaign and Blue Amp Action to help power my fight?](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tab6908e7-9cb1-485e-9bba-5bfa36d9d532/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

**FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE:**
September 15, 2023
Contact: [press@tellitlikeitispac.com](mailto:press@tellitlikeitispac.com?subject=null&body=null)
**Tell It Like It Is PAC Launches New Hampshire TV Spot: “Right Arm”**
**ARLINGTON, VA —** Today, Tell It Like It Is PAC released its latest television ad, the fourth of the 2024 cycle. Entitled “Right Arm,” the :30 second spot is part of a six-figure buy that is airing statewide on broadcast and cable in New Hampshire and across digital platforms.
The ad highlights Governor Christie’s unique track record and ability to get things done, despite having a Democratic legislature for the entirety of his eight-year tenure. As Governor Christie mentions in the ad, he “would’ve given my right arm to have a Republican legislature for one week.”
Under Governor Christie’s leadership, he got Democrats to agree with him to cap property taxes, eliminate the estate tax, and passed pension reform against the public teachers union.
**“Right Arm”**
[](https://tellitlikeitispac.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=104ed976cff8130153157fdb8&id=9bdc0b17a5&e=d0a9afa930)
**TRANSCRIPT FOR “Right Arm” (TV:30)

****Chris Christie:** _I would’ve given my right arm to have a Republican legislature for a week.
__I got pension reform against the public teacher’s union.__
I got a two percent cap on property taxes through a democratic legislature.__
I got the Democrats to eliminate the estate tax.__
We can all fight to get headlines.__
In the end that does nothing for you.__
What I want to do for you is look across from people who I don’t agree with to work with them and to get things down the field for you and put touchdowns in the end zone._

We can’t let it happen. Trump needs to be punished for his crimes, and the trial needs to happen as soon as possible. | Friends,

Attorney General Bob Ferguson is currently celebrating an endorsement from Governor Jay Inslee. This might not come as a surprise given that so far Ferguson is running essentially a campaign for Inslee's fourth term as governor. It's clear that the current AG will continue Inslee's extreme environmental and tax-raising policies in Olympia if voters give him the chance.

This week, candidate Ferguson shared a tweet featuring a quote from Governor Inslee that he will "hold powerful interests accountable and defend our core freedoms." But, as well all know, actions speak louder than words. And the reality of Ferguson's actions tells us that nothing can be further from the truth.

The truth is that Ferguson did absolutely nothing to hold the "powerful accountable" or defend our freedoms" during Inslee's 975-day-long exercise of unchecked executive powers. While Inslee acted with near-dictatorial authority, the AG remained silent, failing to hold him accountable during Inslee's extended unconstitutional power grab.

However, it seems that Ferguson's silence has earned him Inslee's endorsement, bringing him one step closer to his dream of becoming Inslee's successor. It's hard to fathom the negative consequences of - effectively - a 4th term for Inslee. And that's why we need to heighten awareness of these dangers before it's too late.

| | ,

Testimony in Ken Paxton’s impeachment trial has concluded. The evidence elicited at trial clearly indicates that Paxton should be removed from office and barred from holding state office in the future. While Paxton’s attorneys have skillfully challenged every point, the loud flash and bang of their objections and examinations cannot bury the fact that Ken Paxton abused his office by directing state resources to benefit Nate Paul. Why he did it doesn’t matter, but it’s clear that Paxton distrusts law enforcement generally, and, given his eight-year old felony indictment, he found an ally in now-indicted, disgraced Nate Paul.

_Proud to spend time with Beto O'Rourke in El Paso, TX at The Monarch._
As we await the historic verdict which will likely be announced today or tomorrow, I wrote this OpEd piece that was published in the [Galveston County Daily News](https://jaworskifortexas.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2e1f50319ad85f5f9e5c11ac9&id=4cc0f11beb&e=5d8d80652b) and [Meidas Touch](https://jaworskifortexas.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2e1f50319ad85f5f9e5c11ac9&id=c782b8a29e&e=5d8d80652b).

Also, I’m excited to announce that I’ll discuss the verdict next week with [Mothers Against Greg Abbott](https://jaworskifortexas.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2e1f50319ad85f5f9e5c11ac9&id=604fdaa6e8&e=5d8d80652b) during TribFest. We’ll meet at:

body:
Last night, California became the first state to OFFICIALLY call for a Constitutional Amendment to make our communities safer from gun violence.

Friends -
Last night, California became the first state to OFFICIALLY call for a Constitutional Amendment to make our communities safer from gun violence.
Will finding 33 more states calling to amend the Constitution be easy? No, of course not, I am clear-eyed about that.
But it will happen... eventually. And it started here. With us. Thank you for being a part of this team.
Our work becomes more and more important by the day as radical judges use a warped interpretation of our Constitution to roll back state gun safety laws in California, and across the country.
It happened just this week in California where a trio of conservative judges threatened to overturn our state’s ban on unlicensed open carry laws.
So in the face of decades of Congressional inaction and unelected judges that are putting Americans in danger, it is time for citizens to stand up for common sense to protect us against the epidemic of American gun violence.
We need a Constitutional Amendment on guns.
[**Can you use this link to make a contribution to my Campaign for Democracy PAC? The Soros Dynasty just revealed their new plan for 2024: spend whatever it takes to try and stop the _PEOPLE_ from having a voice in their own country.
**_" George Soros' son shifts priorities, resources to focus on defeating MAGA in 2024"_** [Source: _The Post Millennial_]
George Soros has already spent**$50 MILLION** to buy the White House in 2024 - and a Soros-linked Super PAC has also spent **$75 MILLION.**

Friend, left-wing billionaires like Soros have made a fortune off selling out our country - _and YOU_ - for decades!
But when I was in the White House, we upended that status quo. These shadowy special interests know that our movement is the single greatest threat to their grip on power.

body:
We're getting down to the wire, and there's so much at stake. Hey Peter,

Can you believe in less than eight short weeks, Kentuckians will once again head to the polls and make their voices heard about who they want to lead our Commonwealth for the next four years?

We're getting down to the wire, and there's so much at stake. I'm up against Daniel Cameron – Mitch McConnell's protégé who wants to take millions away from public schools, roll back health care access, and so much more. Cameron is too extreme for Kentucky. We can't allow him to drag us backward.

But here's the truth: the work we put in over the next few weeks will make all the difference on November 7. Cameron and his allies are spending millions to attack me, and _Politico_ is calling this matchup "dramatically close."

We need to keep our foot on the gas from now until Election Day to ensure we don't fall behind for even a moment. But we can't do it without your support, Peter.

# 7 Mistakes to Avoid When Hiring a Financial Advisor

---
| _Life should be a balance of adventure and relaxation - not finances._ Enter: Working with a financial advisor. But [choosing the wrong one](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2z9d05ufggcodamkruui9dsm088kkrp00lt8ipqi8_rp22sh2s8i66p71c3g62ob4cdh2bs) could wreak havoc on your retirement.

According to a 2022 Northwestern Mutual study, over 60% of US adults think their financial planning skills need improvement — and yet, only 36% of them work with a financial advisor.1

_Why?_ With thousands of options available, it can seem daunting to choose one. Plus, it can determine your financial trajectory for years to come. But some things are better left to the professionals. While advisors are prohibited from promising returns, research suggests that people work with a financial advisor:
* Feel more at ease about their finances, and
* Could end up with 15% more money to spend in retirement.2

_So, how does that play out over time? _
Let’s pretend we have $500,000 to invest — a good chunk of change. According to a 2019 Vanguard study, here’s what that investment would be worth after 25 years:
* $1.69 million with self-management alone
* $3.4 million with a financial advisor _(read: 2x more)_

In other words, an advisor-managed portfolio would average 8% annualized growth over a 25-year period, compared to just 5% from a self-managed portfolio.3

_Okay... but how do I find one?_
SmartAsset’s [no-cost tool](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zsvk4r394cgl3573l6j3g86nk8g99tjdl3nalbvg_rp22sh2s8i66p71c3g62ob4cdh2bs) simplifies the time consuming process of finding an advisor. A short questionnaire matches you with up to three vetted financial advisors serving your area, each legally bound to work in your best interest. In many cases, you can be connected instantly to compare and decide on the best fit for you.

Ready to know what to look out for? Check out SmartAsset’s list of [seven mistakes to avoid when choosing an advisor](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zhdqregt293hdhsvm9eokdtg1qgq6atj6v47hpg8_rp22sh2s8i66p71c3g62ob4cdh2bs)so you can work towards a more comfortable retirement.

#
Hey Peter, it’s Lucas Kunce.
I wanted to take some time this morning to tell you a little more about the campaign we’re building to defeat Josh Hawley here in Missouri — and why it’s already the boldest grassroots movement our state has ever seen.
**So before I ask you to[chip in any amount toward our goal of raising 2,500 individual donations before midnight tonight,](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/36470?refcode=em20230915-3777&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=3777%2E614464%2EQ7QLmU) will you please let me explain?**
**[ADD A DONATION NOW](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/36470?refcode=em20230915-3777&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=3777%2E614464%2EQ7QLmU)**
For decades, lying politicians have let massive corporations strip our communities for parts — and Missouri has had a front row seat.
I can’t accept a status quo where politicians who take massive donations from Big Ag tell us it’s normal for billionaires in China and Brazil to buy up our farmland and put hard-working family farmers out of business. And I won’t stand for another twenty years of members of Congress who’ve never worn a uniform sacrificing American lives and tax dollars on forever wars, while refusing to invest into the everyday people who make our country strong.
Out-of-touch elites like Josh Hawley have spent decades wasting our money on tax breaks and subsidies for Wall Street, Big Pharma, Big Tech, and just about everything else that’s gutting our country.
They’re willing to lie, cheat, and steal from the American people to protect the corporate PACs and mega-donors who own their careers. And they’ll even raise their fist to look strong before they start running from threats to our democracy.
**We don’t need any more frauds in Congress.** That’s why I’m running for U.S. Senate. It’s why I’m not taking a single cent from corporate PACs. **[And it’s why today, I’m asking you to make your first donation of $10 or whatever you think is best toward our goal of raising 2,500 individual donations before midnight tonight. Can I count on you to help us hit our goal, defeat Josh Hawley, and take this seat back for working people?](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/36470?refcode=em20230915-3777&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=3777%2E614464%2EQ7QLmU)**
If you've stored your info with ActBlue Express, we'll process your contribution instantly:
[Contribute $10](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/36471?refcode=em20230915-3777&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=10&t=4&akid=3777%2E614464%2EQ7QLmU) [Contribute $25](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/36471?refcode=em20230915-3777&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=25&t=5&akid=3777%2E614464%2EQ7QLmU) [Contribute $30](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/36471?refcode=em20230915-3777&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=30&t=6&akid=3777%2E614464%2EQ7QLmU) [Contribute $50](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/36471?refcode=em20230915-3777&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=50&t=7&akid=3777%2E614464%2EQ7QLmU) [Contribute $100](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/36471?refcode=em20230915-3777&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=100&t=8&akid=3777%2E614464%2EQ7QLmU) [Contribute $250](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/36471?refcode=em20230915-3777&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=250&t=9&akid=3777%2E614464%2EQ7QLmU) [Give another amount](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/36470?refcode=em20230915-3777&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=10&akid=3777%2E614464%2EQ7QLmU)

Our mission of taking power back for everyday people has earned our movement national media attention. And our commitment to running this campaign the right way, without a cent from corporate PACs, has given us the ability to run the boldest campaign in Missouri history — taking on corrupt political elites like Hawley without hesitation about some mega-donor being upset.
More than just fighting to codify protections for abortion access — **I’m running to end the filibuster so we can actually get it done.**
More than just banning insider trading among members of Congress and their families — **I’m running to put them in jail if they steal from us.**
More than just breaking up Big Pharma — **I’m running to prosecute the insulin cartels who are killing people.**
And more than just rejecting corporate PAC money — **I’m running to abolish corporate PACs altogether.**
This campaign is powered by the people because that’s exactly who I’ll work for in the U.S. Senate — I'll be accountable to real, everyday Americans, not some corporate executive or political machine. We’re throwing out their rulebook and building a grassroots movement to fundamentally change who has power in our country. **And I need you on our team:**
**[So if you’re ready to help us take back power for everyday people in Missouri and across the country, please add a donation of $25, $10, or whatever you can toward our goal today.](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/36470?refcode=em20230915-3777&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=11&akid=3777%2E614464%2EQ7QLmU)**
**[ADD A DONATION NOW](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/36470?refcode=em20230915-3777&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=12&akid=3777%2E614464%2EQ7QLmU)**
For too long, our country’s corrupt politicians have bought their way into power and maintained a broken status quo. That cycle stops with our movement.
Thanks for being part of it,
Lucas Kunce
