| | |
# 2023 September e-newsletter
News and information for District 5 in San Mateo County.
---
|
---
|
---
| **Bold action required to combat organized retail theft**
---
| Nationwide, we see on the news every night how organized criminal groups are able to ransack businesses and avoid going to jail as individuals only face misdemeanor charges if they have stolen less than $950 in merchandise.
Some of you may have seen a press conference I conducted that was widely covered by the local media and even the national press.
I said ‘enough is enough’ and that whatever the state of California is currently doing is simply not working.

We’ve seen these crimes committed locally at Hillsdale, Tanforan and Serramonte shopping centers, our Ross stores, Sephora and even Lego stores.

To combat the epidemic of organized retail theft locally I am calling on a San Mateo Countywide task force amongst law enforcement and the business community to be formed to tackle this issue head on.

I imagine the taskforce to be similar to the Vehicle Theft Task Force the county has now and have heard a deep interest in law enforcement in establishing a similar task force related to retail theft.

I will be issuing a letter to the Sheriff’s Office and county Police Chiefs Association soon to commence this process
---
and will be asking our county executive’s office and chambers of commerce to also participate in the taskforce. I also sent a letter to our local state elected officials following the press conference demanding the state Legislature take action to combat the epidemic. With that, I’m proud to announce that Gov. Gavin Newsom pledged the largest-ever single investment to combat organized retail crime — **$267,118,293, his office announced Tuesday, Sept. 12 **As part of a competitive grant process, he is recommending the Board of State and Community Corrections (BSCC) award funding to 55 local law enforcement agencies across California. If approved by the Board, the funding, part of the Governor’s [Real Public Safety Plan](https://davidcanepa.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c7592558e548bc8cc150aa5&id=64f7558f9c&e=c0babbc643), is slated to be dispersed on October 1, 2023, to police departments, sheriffs’ departments and district attorney offices in every region of the state to prevent and investigate cases of organized retail theft and arrest and prosecute more suspects, according to Newsom’s office. This is a step in the right direction and I will continue to work locally to protect the public for organized crime rings.
---
| ******County program creates 32 new home cook businesses** Did you know that California became the first state to legalize sales of home-cooked meals with laws passed in 2018 and 2019 for “Microenterprise Home Kitchen Operations” or MEHKO?

I am proud to say that while serving on the San Mateo County Board of Supervisors I sponsored a resolution in 2019 affirming the county’s support for MEHKO and then sponsored an ordinance that allowed for a 2-year pilot in 2021, one of the first in the state to allow home cooks to come out of the shadows.

Now, I am proud to announce that MEHKO has created 32 new businesses and has become a permanent reality in San Mateo County with action the Board took at its Sept. 12 meeting.

Let me tell you a story about Mary. And there are a lot of Marys out there. Mary had to close her housecleaning business of 2 decades or more because the work became too backbreaking for her.

She lost tens of thousands a year in wages and could no longer contribute to the family’s income like she could before. She was looking for a new path and wanted to work but because of certain disabilities she was just unable to.

But Mary is one incredible cook I can tell you who has always hosted big dinners for family and friends with super healthy food. But before MEHKO, if Mary wanted to sell any of her delicious meals, she would have been literally breaking the law.

In 2021, she heard about San Mateo County’s MEHKO pilot, applied for the program, took all the tests and certifications required by the state and county and passed them all.

Now she is the proud owner of Mary’s Small Kitchen in San Mateo. She can work on her time, decide her own menus and even serve people in her home hot home-cooked delicious meals such as meat loaf, lasagnas and her famous grilled chicken sandwiches.

Her home is routinely inspected by Environmental Health to ensure the food she prepares is just as safe as it would be at any restaurant.
If you look at the roster of home cooks you see they are spread throughout the county from Brisbane and Menlo Park, San Mateo, Daly City and more.

You also see that 84 percent of these businesses are owned by women, which shows the need and importance of MEHKO. This is about the Marys of the world. Uplifting those in need and helping them succeed when they otherwise thought they couldn’t.

Congratulations to all the home cooks out there who have created small businesses and for feeding our communities and thanks to Supervisor Ray Mueller for cosponsoring the ordinance with me.

To learn more and how to apply go to: [https://www.smchealth.org/node/4020](https://davidcanepa.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c7592558e548bc8cc150aa5&id=3914626b19&e=c0babbc643).
---
---
| **County creates guaranteed basic income program for foster youth** In a unanimous vote, the San Mateo County Board of Supervisors voted unanimously to provide current and former foster youth ages 18 up to 22 with $1,000 a month in the county’s first guaranteed income program. I was proud to sponsor the resolution with Supervisor Noelia Corzo.

About 70 eligible young adults will receive a direct deposit for up to 18 months.
Our goal is to disrupt the cycle of poverty.

Foster youth face so many challenges that most of us cannot imagine. We as a community want to help these young adults finish high school and go on to college or trades programs without so much of the crushing burden of making ends meet in a county with such a high cost of living.

Foster youth remain very vulnerable to housing instability and homelessness as they age-out of the system. Concrete economic support allows for some relief from the economic pressures that might otherwise push them out of San Mateo County and away from their support systems and friends.

Recipients can use the monthly stipend as they see fit, for education, transportation, housing, food and other needs.

With a secure monthly income floor, it is anticipated that participants will be better able to take advantage of services provided to transitional age foster youth. These include access to educational and financial counselors and a range of support staff that will provide linkages to health and mental health services, employment services and enrichment activities.

The encouragement and financial support are needed to help current and former foster youth navigate the complexities of lease agreements, school and work applications and other responsibilities without families to guide them.

The first $1,000 direct deposits are expected to begin around the New Year. Supervisors approved the program as a pilot that includes a thorough evaluation that will test the impact.
---
| **
This month launches a new Latino Heritage Month speaker series** The inaugural Latino Heritage Month Speaker Series kicks off on Friday, Sept. 15 with Civil Rights activist and Medal of Freedom recipient Sylvia Mendez at the San Mateo Performing Arts Center.

Mendez is also a retired nurse who at age eight, played an instrumental role in the Mendez v. Westminster case, the landmark desegregation case of 1946. The case successfully ended de jure segregation in California and paved the way for integration and the American civil rights movement.

Organized by the Latino Leaders Coalition of the Bay Area (LLCBA), the speaker series celebrates and showcases the rich diversity of the Latino community and is focused on reaching students to help them turn their dreams into reality.

LLCBA is a newly formed organization of San Mateo County Latino school board members and superintendents, which was established to educate, engage, and empower Latino students, families and educators throughout San Mateo County. Kudos to Jennifer Blanco, a San Bruno Park School District trustee and founding member of the coalition, for her effort in launching this exciting new speaker series.
---
| **
Geese get a reprieve in Foster City** It’s been a bit more than a year now since I first conducted a rally with animal rights activists on Aug. 26, 2022 to protest Foster City’s decision to kill 100 geese at the cost of $100,000 to manage the poop problem the birds create.

I was joined by advocates including Erik Allen with Direct Action Everywhere and local elected officials including Foster City Councilman Patrick Sullivan at the rally to urge city leaders to find more humane ways to address the poop problem including developing a comprehensive plan that includes strategic natural landscaping, artificial turf and adding buffer zones along the banks of the city’s lagoons.

I’m proud to say a year later, the city has decided to develop a management plan that will include only non-lethal strategies to manage the geese who call Foster City home.

I said at the rally that we need to learn to live with the geese because, after all, “Everybody Poops.” Marin County nonprofit In Defense of Animals announced that it is giving its “Happy Honk” award to Foster City officials for deciding to use nonlethal means to manage the Canada geese population in the area.

Kudos to the advocates and leaders in Foster City including Mayor Jon Froomin and the City Council for working tirelessly to save the geese from death.

**Battling food insecurity **
Food insecurity is a problem some residents may still face as we continue to emerge from the pandemic. Here are some resources residents can access: **CalFresh:**
Is a program for people with low-income who meet federal income eligibility rules and want to add to their budget to put healthy and nutritious food on the table. Website: [https://www.cdss.ca.gov/food-nutrition/calfresh](https://davidcanepa.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c7592558e548bc8cc150aa5&id=24b3c251db&e=c0babbc643) Contact: (650) 802-6576, [antorres@smcgov.org](mailto:antorres@smcgov.org) **Daly City Partnership:**
DC Partnership is a local partnership that was formed to guide collaborative efforts and connect our community to services that promote well-being. Check out their website for times and locations. Website: [https://www.dcpartnership.org/covid19/](https://davidcanepa.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c7592558e548bc8cc150aa5&id=ef41d433f9&e=c0babbc643) **Second Harvest Food Bank:**
Second Harvest offers food at various locations throughout San Mateo County listed on its webpage. Website: [https://www.shfb.org/get-food/](https://davidcanepa.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c7592558e548bc8cc150aa5&id=2bf390b823&e=c0babbc643) Contacts: Call (800) 984-3663 or text GETFOOD to (408) 455-5181 **Interns wanted to join our team **

We are looking to add to our great group of interns we are currently working with. If you or someone you know may be interested in applying to my Internship Program, submitting this form is the first step: [https://forms.gle/hiKqtn7Rird5vXwB9](https://davidcanepa.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c7592558e548bc8cc150aa5&id=085799b52c&e=c0babbc643). You can also reach out to Mike Richardson on my staff directly with any questions at [mrichardson@smcgov.org](mailto:mrichardson@smcgov.org) In friendship,
David J. Canepa

Supervisor David Canepa1618 Sullivan497Daly City, CA 94015

Want to change how you receive these emails?
You can [update your preferences](https://davidcanepa.us1.list-manage.com/profile?u=a3c7592558e548bc8cc150aa5&id=ea541c4b96&e=c0babbc643&c=c64f3a9486) or [unsubscribe from this list](https://davidcanepa.us1.list-manage.com/unsubscribe?u=a3c7592558e548bc8cc150aa5&id=ea541c4b96&e=c0babbc643&c=c64f3a9486).

| | | It’s Col. Mike Waltz.

I wanted to reach out personally because this is important.

Our mid-month deadline is _**TONIGHT**_ at **MIDNIGHT** , and right now _we’re not at our goal._

I’m not going to lie, I’m getting nervous.

If we’re going to get to work in Washington, we NEED to hold onto our house majority - and that means defending _every single seat._

We have no time to rest and no time to back down.

Please, pitch in before TONIGHT at MIDNIGHT and help us meet our mid-month goal!

body:
RNC Committeewoman Tamara Scott is CONFIRMED for Mackainac! | | |
---
| |
---
| |
# Party of the Constitution
---
**TAMARA SCOTT** , RNC Committeewoman since 2012, has confirmed her attendance at the Mackinac Leadership Conference.
The **NEW MIGOP** , which is led by the grassroots, is committed to making this conference the best one yet. We have an impressive lineup of speakers, including JIM CAVIEZEL, KARI LAKE, VIVEK RAMASWAMY, DINESH D’SOUZA, ZUBY, and now RNC Committeewoman TAMARA SCOTT. We are confident that the upcoming Mackinac Republican Leadership Conference will be unforgettable.
Elected in 2012, Tamara Scott serves as Republican National Committeewoman for Iowa and is honored to serve as Chair of the RNC Faith Advisory Board and the Midwest Regional Representative to the Resolutions Committee. Tamara is also the State Director for the Phyllis Schlafly Eagle’s Constitution Centre, State Director for Concerned Women for America, Legislative Director for Iowa Faith and Freedom Coalition, and host of Truth For Our Time Talk Show.
A multi-media journalist for over 2 decades and a featured speaker, Tamara speaks at commencements, national conferences, rallies, political forums, and debates at the U.S. Capitol, State Houses, college campuses, arenas, and church auditoriums across America. Meeting often with delegations of global and national leaders, she focuses on exchanging ideas to further understanding peace and cultivating compassion for people while respecting the sovereignty of nations. Tamara has been blessed to join several state governors in arenas across the nation, leading thousands in prayer for our country. She was honored to open President Trump’s 2017 Cedar Rapids, IA Rally in prayer.

Tamara has served as a member to the 2016 RNC National Platform Committee, sitting on the National Security Subcommittee; 2015 Iowa - Israel Ambassador CUFI Action Fund; 2012 State Co-Chair Bachmann for President; 2008 RNC National Delegate to the RNC Convention; 2006 State Senate Recruitment Director; 2004 State Co-Chair Bush/Cheney Faith Coalition; 2002 GOTV 72-Hour State Director. She has served on numerous committees and boards, including former president of the Warren County Economic Development Education Foundation and past chair of the Iowa Prayer Breakfast. In 2009 and 2011, she was appointed to the U.S. Commission on Civil Rights State Advisory Committee. In 2007, she was listed as one of the Nation’s Top Ten King Makers by Religion News Service.
Tamara resides in the Des Moines area with her husband, Lowell, and considers
raising God-honoring children of integrity and enjoying time with their families
to be her most important role.
For additional details about our Mackinac Island Conference, please [click here](https://migop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0bcd38e28909007274d8cce33&id=aa2c0a65ad&e=a2af77507c).

We cannot wait to see you at this historic conference.

In appreciation, if you donate at least $150 during the telethon, I will mail you an autographed copy of my critically acclaimed book, "The Authoritarians.” Remember, every dollar makes a huge difference and will help restore constitutional government to America. Our Constitution hangs on by a single thread. We have got to rise and save the Constitution before it is too late. Tune in on September 18, make a generous donation, and invite others to do the same. Let’s make the telethon a whopping success for the future of every American. In Defense of Liberty, JonathanJonathan W. body:
https://rokhanna.com [https://rokhanna.com]

Friend,

There are currently 1,800 Big Pharma lobbyists on Capitol Hill —that’s more than three lobbyists for every member of Congress. Many of those lobbyists were once members themselves, which gives them unprecedented access to our elected officials.

This level of corporate influence has dire consequences. A 2021 STAT study found that two-thirds of Congress received campaign contributions from Big Pharma in the 2020 election; Pfizer’s PAC alone spent over $14.8 million [https://www.opensecrets.org/orgs/pfizer-inc/summary?id=D000000138] on lobbying in 2022. Drug companies are doling out millions of dollars to lawmakers to keep the cost of life-saving medications sky-high and line the pockets of their shareholders.

This is why I refuse to take PAC money. And it’s why I founded the No PAC Caucus, comprised of bipartisan lawmakers dedicated to serving the American people above all else. People should not have to forgo their vital medication because of Big Pharma’s greed.

I will always prioritize people over profits, but it’s going to take support from as many members of Congress as possible to fight Big Pharma’s influence.

Tell Congress: Reject Big Pharma. Sign the No PAC Pledge. [https://act.rokhanna.com/a/reject-big-pharma-pac-spending-petition?contactdata=S1Op8B0RMbCu1GtFe1m2FHSIE99IbGHxnQOTmUYc3ojzV/cMUTHrgneAg5/lRPB5j8MQBL/XqlMuTzGqX/ivXVrr4uAHDr2/vBQpr1ktmFnInD/iBRbQwTaMFGX9WVm+HuTy55Je6MmO5CxFDH4/oQ==]

Let’s make one thing clear: We can’t call ourselves a democracy if we don’t work for the people who elect us. We must bolt shut the revolving door between Capitol Hill and lobbying firms. We need to get corporate money out, and get to work!

In solidarity,
Ro

Opinion: The Fate of Our Country Hangs in the Balance, Nothing Is More Important than Electing Donald J. Trump President in 2024 (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2023/09/opinion-the-fate-of-our-country-hangs-in-the-balance-nothing-is-more-important-than-electing-donald-j-trump-president-in-2024.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=9da43fc392-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_09_15_02_50&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-9da43fc392-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)
https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2023/09/opinion-the-fate-of-our-country-hangs-in-the-balance-nothing-is-more-important-than-electing-donald-j-trump-president-in-2024.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=9da43fc392-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_09_15_02_50&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-9da43fc392-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D
(ABC News)
By Mark Vargas and Scott Kaspar

The 2024 presidential election is the most consequential election in our lifetime – if not, ever.

Under the Biden administration – small businesses were decimated during the pandemic; schools were shut down; children were forced into remote learning away from their friends and forced to wear masks upon their return to the classroom; first responders – police officers and firefighters, teachers, flight attendants, airline pilots and frontline healthcare workers were demonized and even terminated from their jobs for refusing to take the COVID vaccine.

But that’s not all.

Under the Biden administration, school districts across the country are teaching a national sexual education curriculum that teaches students about gender identity, hormone blockers and how to preform various sexual acts on a person – topics completely inappropriate for children.

In addition to this perverted curriculum, these same school districts are sowing the seeds of hate by introducing topics like critical race theory – which teaches students about race superiority and that we are fundamentally a racist, no good country.

And it’s why many young people have grown to dislike the American flag – even refusing to stand or acknowledge the flag during the playing of our national anthem.

And what does the Biden administration do to parents who bravely and peacefully confront their school board members and district officials and advocate on behalf of the children?

The Biden administration labels them “domestic terrorists.”

But that’s not all.

Under the Biden administration, it’s now illegal to question the legitimacy of an election.

But as a Democratic U.S. Senator –
Joe Biden (https://nypost.com/2020/09/19/biden-spent-years-warning-of-voter-fraud-now-call-a-myth/?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=9da43fc392-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_09_15_02_50&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-9da43fc392-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) spent his entire career from 1973-2009 – warning the country about the dangers of voter fraud.

In 2001, then President Bill Clinton, while on a trip to
Chicago (https://grabien.com/file.php?id=1571945&utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=9da43fc392-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_09_15_02_50&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-9da43fc392-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) said that Al Gore won the popular vote, and that the only way Republicans could win the 2000 election was to “stop the vote in Florida.”

In 2002, former Democratic presidential candidate Al Gore told the
Washington Post (https://www.washingtonpost.com/archive/politics/2002/11/15/gore-calls-2000-verdict-crushing-assails-court/0108a5e5-0cb2-4511-aad9-14a05e8547f7/?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=9da43fc392-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_09_15_02_50&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-9da43fc392-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) that he believed “if everyone in Florida who tried to vote had his or her vote counted properly, that I would have won.”

In 2017, during Donald Trump’s Presidential Inauguration,
67 Democratic (https://abcnews.go.com/Politics/50-democratic-congress-members-planning-skip-inauguration/story?id=44783997&utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=9da43fc392-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_09_15_02_50&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-9da43fc392-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) Members of Congress skipped the inaugural festivities, claiming that his election was “illegitimate.”

In 2018, Democrat
Stacy Abrams (https://freebeacon.com/politics/12-times-stacey-abrams-said-she-got-cheated-in-georgia/?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=9da43fc392-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_09_15_02_50&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-9da43fc392-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) questioned the “legitimacy of the election” after she lost her race for Georgia governor and refused to concede.

Under the Biden administration,
it’s now illegal for a lawyer to represent a client (https://www.newsmax.com/politics/giuliani-rudy/2023/08/30/id/1132649/?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=9da43fc392-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_09_15_02_50&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-9da43fc392-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) who raises the flag about election fraud – as in the case of former New York City Mayor Rudy Giuliani.

But that’s not all.

Under the Biden administration, every day hard working Americans are being silenced on social media platforms for expressing opinions that do not align with the progressive liberal agenda.

Post about your support of President Trump and the Make America Great Again movement on your personal Facebook page during non-business hours and you may face termination by your employer.

America has never been in a more perilous spot.

The God-given, unalienable rights that formed our “more perfect union” are being weakened before our eyes. We are in a constitutional crisis where swift action must be taken now at the executive level to correct the course and right the ship.

And the only way to stop this madness is to wholeheartedly support the leading candidate for the Republican nomination for president – and that’s President Donald J. Trump – who leads his closest challenger – Florida Gov. Ron DeSantis by nearly 50 points.

https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2023/09/opinion-the-fate-of-our-country-hangs-in-the-balance-nothing-is-more-important-than-electing-donald-j-trump-president-in-2024.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=9da43fc392-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_09_15_02_50&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-9da43fc392-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D
A latest Fox News poll has President Donald Trump leading Florida Gov. Ron DeSantis by nearly 50 points.
The people have spoken – and President Trump isn’t just leading by a little – he’s leading by a lot. It’s not even close.

And where is our Republican leadership in Illinois? They are out there promoting Florida Gov. Ron DeSantis, who trails President Trump by nearly 50 points.

They are also working on a “plan” for reversing the Democrat’s stranglehold on our lives by focusing on a handful of state representative and state senate races to try and “chip away” at the Democratic supermajority control in Springfield.

And the architect of this plan? Illinois Republican national committeeman Richard Porter – the chief architect of the failed Richard Irvin campaign for governor who lost to the grassroots candidate by 43 points.

In many of these same races, the IL GOP establishment is quietly running its preferred candidates against those carrying grassroots’ support – despite saying publicly that they will stay neutral during the 2024 primary.

That’s right – the Illinois GOP is still meddling in local races – pitting establishment Republicans against grassroots Republicans.

The idea that you could “chip away” at the Democrat’s supermajority control in Illinois in a single election is absurd.

But let’s focus on local Illinois races and ignore the global initiatives that the Biden administration is tying us to, like the UN’s and World Economic Forum’s
Agenda 2030 (https://sdgs.un.org/2030agenda?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=9da43fc392-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_09_15_02_50&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-9da43fc392-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) where Chicago (https://www.c40.org/cities/?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=9da43fc392-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_09_15_02_50&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-9da43fc392-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) will be one of 14 cities in the US slated to become a “Smart City” by 2030 – which means Chicagoans will have to forego (https://www.c40.org/accelerators/good-food-cities/?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=9da43fc392-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_09_15_02_50&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-9da43fc392-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) meat and dairy in just 7 years’ time.

That’s right: no more meat or dairy.

And driving a gas-powered vehicle?
Forget (https://www.c40.org/accelerators/green-healthy-streets/?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=9da43fc392-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_09_15_02_50&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-9da43fc392-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) about it.

But the political geniuses within the IL GOP know better – and the real fight is not to defeat Joe Biden and elect Donald Trump – but to focus on races that will not move the needle or make any difference at all in Illinois.

In the Illinois Senate, Democrats maintain a 41-18 supermajority control.

In the Illinois House, Democrats maintain a 78-39 supermajority control.

Do you think Illinois Republicans will have any say in Springfield anytime soon? Absolutely not.

It took over 17,000 years for glaciers to “chip away” at the earth and become the Great Lakes, and even that amount of time may not be long enough to reverse the Democrat’s control of Springfield.

But what do we know – clearly IL GOP leaders know better.

Mark Vargas is Editor-in-Chief of Illinois Review and a columnist with Newsmax. From 2007-2010, he served as a civilian in the Office of the U.S. Secretary of Defense, traveling to Baghdad, Iraq 14 times. # **A Message from the Chairwoman**
---
| |
# _Register to Vote_
---
When we turn on the news or scroll through the internet, we are often inundated with news about the 2024 elections. While next year will be crucially important, the fact of the matter is we have critically important municipal elections less than two months away. Local government is the government closest to the people and thriving cities and towns are vital for our state to continue to grow and move in the right direction. As such, I want to make sure that you are ready to vote in 2023. To be prepared to participate in the upcoming election, please visit [indianavoters.in.gov](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/4d89c03d9b4ea0153947229f28c3afba/e6337bb4b7d59ed3c3d6b838967d376c/40313) to either register to vote or confirm your registration. **The last day to register for this November's election is October 10, 2023**. Furthermore, please take a few minutes this weekend and share this information with your family and friends. Getting you and your family registered to vote is an important way to make sure Republicans are turning out this November. With your help, we will have another strong municipal election cycle which will be crucial to making sure our cites and towns are set up for success. Thank you,
---
---
Chairwoman Anne F. Hathaway

# **Governor Eric Holcomb's Week in Review**
---
| |
# 🗾 _IN Japan_
---
---
| | _**Governor Eric Holcomb** speaks during the 53rd Annual Joint Meeting of the Japan-Midwest U.S. and Midwest U.S.-Japan Associations in Tokyo._**
---
This week,**Governor Eric Holcomb **was on an international economic development trip to Japan, a trip that will mark the his third official visit to the state’s largest foreign investor.
* Indiana is home to more than 1,050 foreign-owned business establishments, including more than 300 from Japan that employ more than 55,000 Hoosier jobs.
* Among all U.S. states, Indiana has the largest amount of Japanese investment per capita

**What he's saying:** “The Indiana-Japan relationship is storied and strong, and I look forward to again visiting our friends in Japan and identifying new opportunities to further grow our cultural and economic partnerships,” said **Gov. Holcomb**.**
* “Japan and Indiana share so many industry strengths and, with our shared commitment to building economies of the future, we are together poised to lead, innovate, and develop the future of advanced manufacturing, energy and mobility.”

**While IN Japan:** **Gov. Holcomb** spoke to Indiana media while in Tokyo, stating he is confident that the trip will bear fruit for Indiana.
* “We were born and raised Hoosiers — I was, at least — and kind of ‘Midwest-nice,’ and we like to be polite and be accounted for. (But) the world’s run by those who show up. And we show up.”

**What else happened this week?****Gov. Holcomb**[ordered flags at half-staff](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/4d89c03d9b4ea0153947229f28c3afba/9f1cb9e5e752468ac3d6b838967d376c/40313) for Patriot Day and honored the victims of Sept. 11, 2001.****

Holcomb** on [Facebook](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/4d89c03d9b4ea0153947229f28c3afba/c774c951a04b3821c3d6b838967d376c/40313) or [Twitter](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/4d89c03d9b4ea0153947229f28c3afba/872819613b00bdcec3d6b838967d376c/40313).

body:
https://www.everyaction.com/ [https://www.everyaction.com/]
Peter,
Happy Hispanic Heritage Month!
Freedom Virginia recognizes the tireless efforts of the Latino community. The work never stops, and we believe that we are stronger when we come together! That’s why we are fighting.
Affordable healthcare is a right we all share, but a reality few of us have. The truth is 1 out of 4 Virginians who need prescription medication, can’t take it because they can’t afford it.
In 2019, Black and Latino Virginians were far more likely to lack health insurance than White Virginians. The Department of Health and Human Services determined in 2019, that Black and Latino Medicare beneficiaries over the age of 65 were 1.5 times as likely to report out-of-pocket prescription drug challenges than their White counterparts.

body:

I'm really proud of what we've accomplished in the first 8 months since Aruna and I took office. We:
* Passed (with bipartisan support) all 10 of the bills I introduced to the legislature, including a first-in-the-nation program for a paid year of service for high school graduates
* Made Maryland a leader in what it looks like to be an abortion care safe haven
* Signed the Trans Health Equality Law
* Passed critical gun safety legislation... and then got sued by the NRA (something our administration will take as a badge of honor)

But we've also had hard times. This year's mass shootings in Annapolis, Baltimore, and Salisbury are a painful reminder there's a lot more work to do to address gun violence and safety in communities all across our state. Supreme Court rulings have upended decades of work to reduce discrimination in our country. Now more than ever it’s crucial that we speak up.

| | On September 15th, 2008 – fifteen years ago – economic turmoil could already be felt across the United States. But when Lehman Brothers filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy, the economy accelerated into what can only be described as a freefall. At the time, this was the largest bankruptcy filing in U.S. history. The Dow Jones plummeted 500 points that day, and within weeks thousands of people lost their jobs. Arizona saw its unemployment rate rise from 3.7% to 11.2%. **That equates to 1 in 9 people being unemployed.** At the time, my wife and I were both working in finance. I remember seeing my colleagues as they heard the news for the first time, their faces overcome with what can only be described as fear, an emotion many Americans felt on that day. Scores of Americans lost their retirement, life savings, and their jobs. My wife – who had been working at Credit Suisse, the company where we met – was one of those who was laid off in the ensuing economic downturn. Financially we were able to survive, but I'll never forget when she came home and told me. Millions of families were impacted by the crash and the recession that followed. It took years for our country to recover – which was slowed by obstructionists, like David Schweikert, who spent the 2010s weakening critical reforms, such as the Dodd-Frank Act, and harming Arizonans, **who didn't see pre-recession employment levels until 2016.** We need responsible legislation to safeguard the American economy and ensure everyone can benefit from it. We cannot afford for David Schweikert, special interests, and their allies to stand in the way. This week I released an Op-ed discussing the Lehman Brothers crash and what it means today. You can find it in today's print edition of the Arizona Capitol Times, or on their website. **[Please click here to read the full Op-ed.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/69790970/427306934/1238818695?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc0NDIiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYzNjNzU2ODQtZTY1My1lZTExLTk5MzctMDAyMjQ4MzJlODExIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=zpsovGMBBw-cRMxEwScPue38mPCVFwa1Wrs1Phi4KZE=&emci=24851948-5153-ee11-9937-00224832e811&emdi=c3c75684-e653-ee11-9937-00224832e811&ceid=7520491)** [Read now](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/69790971/427306935/1238818695?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc0NDIiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYzNjNzU2ODQtZTY1My1lZTExLTk5MzctMDAyMjQ4MzJlODExIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=zpsovGMBBw-cRMxEwScPue38mPCVFwa1Wrs1Phi4KZE=&emci=24851948-5153-ee11-9937-00224832e811&emdi=c3c75684-e653-ee11-9937-00224832e811&ceid=7520491) I am running for Congress because we need a congressman who will fight special interests and make the economy work for all of us. clean_body: | | | | On September 15th, 2008 – fifteen years ago – economic turmoil could already be felt across the United States. But when Lehman Brothers filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy, the economy accelerated into what can only be described as a freefall. At the time, this was the largest bankruptcy filing in U.S. history. The Dow Jones plummeted 500 points that day, and within weeks thousands of people lost their jobs. Arizona saw its unemployment rate rise from 3.7% to 11.2%. That equates to 1 in 9 people being unemployed. At the time, my wife and I were both working in finance. I remember seeing my colleagues as they heard the news for the first time, their faces overcome with what can only be described as fear, an emotion many Americans felt on that day. Scores of Americans lost their retirement, life savings, and their jobs. My wife – who had been working at Credit Suisse, the company where we met – was one of those who was laid off in the ensuing economic downturn. Financially we were able to survive, but I'll never forget when she came home and told me. Millions of families were impacted by the crash and the recession that followed. It took years for our country to recover – which was slowed by obstructionists, like David Schweikert, who spent the 2010s weakening critical reforms, such as the Dodd-Frank Act, and harming Arizonans, who didn't see pre-recession employment levels until 2016. We need responsible legislation to safeguard the American economy and ensure everyone can benefit from it. We cannot afford for David Schweikert, special interests, and their allies to stand in the way. This week I released an Op-ed discussing the Lehman Brothers crash and what it means today. You can find it in today's print edition of the Arizona Capitol Times, or on their website. I am running for Congress because we need a congressman who will fight special interests and make the economy work for all of us. Together we can beat Schweikert and stand up for hard-working Arizonans. = Conor | Express Donate: If you've stored your info with ActBlue Express, we'll process your contribution instantly: | = | = | = | = ---|---|---|--- | | | Paid for and authorized by Conor for AZ. |

Friends,
Over the last few weeks, I've shared some of the successes of our State Freedom Caucuses from this year's legislative sessions, proving the model that we built from the House Freedom Caucus in D.C. is working... and working well!
Elections are the cornerstone of our republic but public trust in the integrity of the voting process is at an all time low. Without secure elections, our republic is destined to fall.
One of the most egregious election interferences we face are states with open primaries, allowing cross-over voting between the parties. As a result, red states have seen their Republican primaries flooded with Democrats, leading to victory for RINOs in areas where the electorate is overwhelmingly conservative.
The **Wyoming Freedom Caucus** took this fight head on and was able to successfully pass HB 103 that closes the state's primary elections to prevent interference from cross-over voting. The Liz Cheneys of the future will have a much harder time getting elected thanks to the Wyoming Freedom Caucus.
But the fight in Wyoming was just the beginning. Many of our other State Freedom Caucuses made election integrity a top priority before 2024, resulting in massive wins across the country:
* The **Arizona Freedom Caucus** successfully led efforts to place a resolution on the 2024 ballot to ban ranked choice voting and also successfully led efforts to kill SB 1518 which would have permitted early voting ballots to be verified without a signature.
* The **Georgia Freedom Caucus** successfully led the efforts to kill HB 200, a bill that would have enacted Ranked Choice Voting in the state. They also helped pass HB 222 to ban "Zuckerbucks," which consists of tax-exempt charitable organizations providing direct or indirect support to the official election process.
* The **Idaho Freedom Caucus** pushed a law prohibiting Ranked Choice Voting (HB 179) and successfully sponsored legislation banning the use of student ID cards at the polls (HB 124).
* The **Louisiana Freedom Caucus** successfully introduced and passed a Constitutional Amendment through the legislature to ban "Zuckerbucks" in the state. The Amendment will be on the ballot on October 14, 2023 for citizen approval.
* After the **Mississippi Freedom Caucus** was unsuccessful in passing an anti-ballot harvesting bill in the 2022 session, the MSFC circulated a public petition collecting thousands of signatures, setting the stage for two anti-ballot harvesting bills in the 2023 session. The MSFC successfully authored and passed HB 1306, which codifies the crime of ballot harvesting and disqualifies any candidate for office who has failed to file all financial or ethics reports within the last 5 years preceding the election. The MSFC also helped champion and pass SB 2358, which further defined ballot harvesting and gave legislative intent for the crime.
* The **Montana Freedom Caucus** successfully championed a "Zuckerbucks" bill, Senate Bill 117, which ensured that all funding for elections is paid for by Montanans' tax dollars without outside influence.
* The **South Carolina Freedom Caucus** filed a lawsuit against a state law which restricted any legislative caucus that was not constituted by one of the major parties from engaging in elections, campaigning, or fundraising for candidates. A Federal Judge ruled in favor of the South Carolina Freedom Caucus's argument, stating that the law violated the 1st and 14th amendments.
* **The South Dakota Freedom Caucus** successfully led a grassroots initiative to create greater transparency in the election process by demanding filing records be made public. Subsequent legislation was introduced and enacted resulting in the state's first election audit.

These accomplishments are solid steps in the right direction, and they should be applauded, but they are simply not enough. Much more needs to be done to help restore trust in our elections. As our Network expands into more states and as more members join each caucus, we pledge to keep fighting for election integrity. Imagine what we could do if we had a Freedom Caucus in all 50 states!
If you share our vision and want to support our efforts, please donate as we take the fight for conservative values and individual liberty all over America.

**Keep fighting,**

**Andy Roth**

Florida Governor Ron DeSantis had absolutely nothing on his schedule for his official duties as Governor of Florida on September 14, 2023, which also happened to be his 45th birthday. Instead of spending his birthday in Florida on Thursday, a weekday, in which he is supposed to be working as Governor of Florida, a job he is paid to do with Florida tax payer money, DeSantis spent his birthday fundraising for his failed Presidential campaign in New York City with elitist Wall Street donors.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/2bd1dca3-bb87-4476-9bf5-4e03867ec3bc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
DeSantis kicked his birthday morning off with a breakfast fundraiser in New York City that was hosted by several wealthy executives, including attorney William Burck, David Blumberg, the founder of Blumberg Capital, Steve Hornstein, an executive at the investment advisory firm Global Credit Advisers, and Mark Gerson, the co-founder of financial information services company Gerson Lehrman Group. Attendees of the fundraiser had to pay an astounding $11,600 per plate entry price.
This week, US Senator and former Presidential candidate Mitt Romney announced he isn't running for re-election to the US Senate in a cryptic video message. His announcement came two days after I posted exclusive photos of him while he was traveling solo at the Palm Beach International airport in Florida, where Ron DeSantis is Governor. Was Mitt Romney fundraising for Ron DeSantis in Palm Beach, home to President Trump and mega donor central? Perhaps, and Ron DeSantis's recent fundraising trip to New York City with some of Mitt Romney's closest advisors adds fuel to the fire.
There is no such thing as a coincidence. And it appears that just days after Romney was spotted in Florida, and announced he won't be seeking re-election, all of his biggest financial backers from 2012 are hosting high dollar fundraisers for Ron DeSantis in the same week in the tristate area. The attendees and host committees of the fundraisers all included prominent donors to Senator Mitt Romney.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..AgpFlHd_1lSyuuYLpoPdyswryqaGE1AM9DhtUXw_kSI?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=137069480)
William A. Burck is a prolific Mitt Romney donor who contributed over $27,000 to Romney's failed 2012 Presidential campaign through various avenues. Burck also donated to the comically inept 2016 Republican Presidential campaign of Jeb Bush when Bush was challenging Donald Trump for the 2016 GOP Presidential nomination.
**See evidence of Burck 's contributions to Bush and Romney below...**

David Blumberg, another high-dollar DeSantis donor who was raising money for the failed candidate in New York at the breakfast fundraiser, has a history of donating to DeSantis allies, including Nevada Senator Adam Laxalt, [who was once roommates with DeSantis during naval officer training. ](https://substack.com/redirect/272a2a75-a1db-44eb-9893-244bbaadf64f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
In October of 2022, I reported how Ron DeSantis had a secret meeting in Utah with Mitt Romney. At the time, DeSantis was planning to bring on Mitt Romney's Presidential campaign apparatus for his own 2024 anti-Trump Presidential campaign which DeSantis has been plotting since 2020. Of course, DeSantis and Romney have a very public shared hatred of former President Donald Trump and a mutual interest in making sure President Trump is not elected in 2024.
Through a recent investigation into Romney's campaign finances, I was able to uncover the fact that Romney's campaign account was given a whopping $714,004.14 on June 21st, 2023 by an outfit called 'Targeted Victory LLC.' 'Targeted Victory LLC' is a company run by a man named Zac Moffat, who previously worked for Romney as his 'digital director.' Moffat now works with Senator Tim Scott, another Republican opponent of President Donald Trump in the 2024 Republican primary. See [evidence ](https://substack.com/redirect/442fd845-8bf5-448d-bec7-3023354444a7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)of that transaction courtesy of the Federal Election Commission's campaign election finance database below.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/c54622d1-c5c7-4782-a2c2-5ff056089ac0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Whether it be through Ron DeSantis, or Senator Tim Scott, Mitt Romney seems to be heavily involved in attempts to stop Donald Trump from becoming the Republican nominee for President in 2024.
Following his birthday fundraiser breakfast, Ron DeSantis bolted over to a fundraiser luncheon for his Presidential campaign that was hosted by Emil Henry, the CEO of the private equity firm Tiger Infrastructure Partners. Emil Henry is a longtime GOP fundraiser and was an advisor to Sen. Mitt Romney's 2012 Presidential campaign. Emil Henry also worked as the assistant secretary of the Treasury during President George W. Bush's administration. In 2015, when former Florida Governor Jeb Bush was running for President in a crowded GOP primary against then candidate Donald Trump, [Emil Henry hosted a fundraiser for Jeb Bush in the Hamptons.](https://substack.com/redirect/ee19d988-2fac-473f-b571-7c8e6b57da54?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
[](https://substack.com/redirect/ad135b26-8ad0-489b-9baf-af931e8908ac?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Additionally, on Wednesday September 13, 2023, the day before Ron DeSantis's birthday, his afternoon schedule in Tallahassee for his Gubernatorial duties was also cleared so that he could fly to Greenwich, Connecticut for another swanky campaign fundraiser on taxpayer dime.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/7d308d89-632d-4608-8c1f-0c01a29eac27?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
A screenshot of the Governor's schedule shows he didn't do any work on September 14th (his birthday), and on September 13th, he canceled work for the rest of the day following a 10 am EST roundtable.
It is worth noting that Greenwich, CT is the wealthiest zip code in America aside from 33480 in Palm Beach, Florida. DeSantis's purpose of being there was to attend a fundraiser for his Presidential campaign at the home of Connecticut GOP fundraiser Scott Frantz.
Frantz hosted high dollar fundraisers for Mitt Romney, John McCain, and George W. Bush when they ran for President. Franz also donated $100,000 to @MittRomney's Super PAC and once raised $1.5 MILLION for Mitt Romney in one single day.
To attend the VIP reception at this Greenwich fundraiser and to get a photo with Ron DeSantis, couples had to pay $23,200. The event also offered VIP admission to bundlers who have raised $50,000 or more for DeSantis's Presidential campaign.

clean_body: This woman is incredible, join me in celebrating her special day!| | | I'll be quick, folks. Today is my wife's birthday! This is proof that I didn't forget it.... Mary Pat has been through it all with me and she has never left my side no matter how hard things get. She is my best friend and the best thing that ever happened to me. She supports my mission and dream of a better nation, all while being an incredible mother, wife, and woman. I know she will appreciate seeing your support and all your birthday wishes! \- Chris | | | | | | | | ---|---|---|---

subject: Fani Willis Under Attack By GOP

body:
Peter,

When Governor Brian Kemp signed SB 92 into law to punish duly-elected Georgia prosecutors, my fellow Democratic lawmakers and I pointed out that it would be abused ... but we didn’t expect it to happen this fast.

Extremists in the Georgia GOP are moving to use this law to punish District Attorney Fani Willis for indicting the former MAGA President Trump, proving once again that they believe the law only applies when it suits their goals.

We need to free Georgia of legislators who trample on our rights. That is what the Georgia House Democrats do every single day: we work to uphold and expand the rights of all Georgians while supporting Democratic candidates and legislators.

This may seem distant and abstract, but it’s not. It’s a fight for our future.

We hope you’ll join us in this fight – and show radical Republicans that no one is above the law.

UAW workers made great sacrifices, including wage and benefit cuts, during the Great Recession. Now, companies are making record profits, and UAW workers are collectively bargaining for a fair contract to ensure every worker, not just those at the top, get their fair share. Unions helped build America’s middle class. Autoworkers in my hometown of Flint, Michigan, were the first to sit down and strike for better wages and better benefits in the 1930s. Today, thousands of UAW members who build award-winning cars in my district are standing up to strike for those same reasons. I am proud to stand in solidarity with the UAW members on the picket line today, and I know the American people stand with them too. In solidarity, Dan Kildee

| Speaker McCarthy announced the House of Representatives would open an impeachment inquiry into Joe Biden.
You're going to see a lot of hand wringing from the left and their allies in the media about this commonsense step, so I wanted to share my thoughts on this subject and why I support opening this inquiry.
Yes, it's reasonable to open an impeachment inquiry when a particularly suspicious set of facts has emerged that warrant further investigation. Let's review those facts:

1. Almost $20 million in payments were directed to Biden's associates and family through different shell companies, according to bank records.
2. The Treasury Department obtained more than 150 transactions involving the Bidens and other associates that were flagged by American banks as "suspicious activity."
3. There's eyewitness testimony that Joe Biden joined multiple phone calls and had conversations that resulted in cars and millions of dollars being given to Hunter Biden and his son's business partners.
4. Hunter Biden implicated his dad in conversations with CCP officials, with whom he was attempting to do business. A WhatsApp message from Hunter in 2017, obtained by the IRS, stated "I am sitting here with my father and we would like to understand why the commitment made has not been fulfilled." This was in regards to a $100,000 payment to Hunter from a suspected CCP official and businessman.
5. The White House story on this subject has changed multiple times, which only increases suspicions. First, they claimed that Joe Biden had no knowledge whatsoever of Hunter Biden's business dealings. And now, after facts have emerged that expose the obvious lie of their original claim, they are saying that Joe Biden was not *involved* in Hunter Biden's business. This rapid about-face in the White House's response raises serious concerns.

An impeachment inquiry will allow access to more documents that could highlight corruption or pay-for-play. It will provide the apex of investigative authority and is necessary for the House to perform proper oversight.
This inquiry will help House Republicans to get the facts. If you have nothing to hide, you shouldn't oppose a fact-finding mission.
I will keep you updated as this inquiry proceeds.

| Here's one for the ages. The President who accuses Republicans of trying to take away health care access is limiting your access to short-term health plans. This is part two of the great, "if you like your plan, you can keep your plan" lie.
In 2018, the Trump Administration expanded plan offerings by removing unnecessary federal requirements around short-term health insurance. The idea is simple: if you need comprehensive long-term coverage, you get comprehensive long-term coverage. If you need short-term insurance - maybe you're between plans or young and healthy - get short-term insurance. It's grounded in the principle of choice.
Biden doesn't like the concept of short-term coverage, and claims that he is protecting the consumer. But while he thinks he knows better than you, his policy ignores some really important facts:
We will have more uninsured people without these plans. Based on an average of projections from the Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services Office of the Actuary, the Congressional Budget Office, the Center for Health Economy, the Urban Institute, and the Commonwealth Fund, the current proposed changes to the 2018 rule will likely leave millions of Americans uninsured. In addition, the regulatory impact analysis concedes that spending will increase. So, we're spending more money to insure fewer people? That's backwards.
Effectively, this will eliminate a key protection for people with preexisting conditions. It would mean that a person who gets sick during the coverage period will lose insurance protection when that coverage period ends. Why? Biden's proposal would destroy the current 1 year coverage timeframe by limiting the short-term insurance to 3 months with a single 1 month renewal. This would also impact a person that is unemployed for more than 3 months.
The current regulation offers coverage at lower premiums, and the Biden policy would increase premiums and cost to the taxpayer. The non-partisan U.S. CBO [reports](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001r2UNgCQw7jriASgfdhww_EY1MzKqXc0GhqvtDF2ti8TtdSm6maHPZOcyWHuXmO9OrQorwQlMcHPUVpwXnmxGw0wj1e8BQtCKTYKInSAT_TUSCB1yHto6-P2lpmKh8JgStHSVdEQpeDdYmMjrqgGdb2a1q-gQXKEAgcAUFYjkjk8=&c=Qc-oT32Lwoj-j9ZVbgyHckUSpxphJFxX-8b0t0nBE6iwSuQDz6upxA==&ch=0AgdH12NpjPSnVDoPSLHHNee_unl8zYLciB79UWHjyohVKfcTScnTg==) that these short-term plans often "have lower deductibles or wider provider networks than plans in the fully regulated nongroup market" at premiums "as much as 60 percent lower than premiums for the lowest-cost bronze plan." Short-term plans strengthen the market.
Some individuals who lose short-term coverage will choose Affordable Care Act coverage instead, where they will face substantially higher premiums, narrower networks and higher cost-sharing. How do we know this? Last year [78% of premiums](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001r2UNgCQw7jriASgfdhww_EY1MzKqXc0GhqvtDF2ti8TtdSm6maHPZOcyWHuXmO9OoJtNk_PfLuWNRu-WYQhG9v79pJhYzRDeKRnzF05_2sCWXcGlw9k_F4LYhVJOhUHPNk2Tp1oD2acJVZivsmDqsGOpZ5FDFKU7usanJMBuB5HbQ5NKY5G2NtdufD66k-oTJ3cKAJri30WcCHMiiAYdlrCvQEkwQDXbUolfFI45tj8MvuL9Qoe2-g==&c=Qc-oT32Lwoj-j9ZVbgyHckUSpxphJFxX-8b0t0nBE6iwSuQDz6upxA==&ch=0AgdH12NpjPSnVDoPSLHHNee_unl8zYLciB79UWHjyohVKfcTScnTg==) collected by insurers for their exchange plans came not from the people enrolled in the plan but from the federal government's subsidies - a reflection of rising costs. Expect federal spending of your taxpayer dollars to go up.
Let me spell it out in simple terms. For 10 months out of the year, people cannot buy ACA plans, and the Biden Administration's solution is to punish people that don't purchase comprehensive coverage. Everyone has unique needs, and the last thing we should be doing is narrowing the number of plan options for all Americans. Let Americans choose what's best for them.

I also called out Biden for his proposed rule change that will actually limit millions of Americans' access to short-term health insurance. The End-Of-Quarter FEC fundraising deadline is just two weeks away. Your donations support a full-time staff of talented writers, video producers, and event coordinators who are helping us win elections and grow the conservative movement. == Now, here's your campaign brief: | | | | | | | | HERE'S WHY THE IMPEACHMENT INQUIRY AGAINST BIDEN IS WARRANTED | | | == | == | | | Speaker McCarthy announced the House of Representatives would open an impeachment inquiry into Joe Biden. You're going to see a lot of hand wringing from the left and their allies in the media about this commonsense step, so I wanted to share my thoughts on this subject and why I support opening this inquiry. Yes, it's reasonable to open an impeachment inquiry when a particularly suspicious set of facts has emerged that warrant further investigation. Let's review those facts: 1. Almost $20 million in payments were directed to Biden's associates and family through different shell companies, according to bank records. 2. The Treasury Department obtained more than 150 transactions involving the Bidens and other associates that were flagged by American banks as "suspicious activity." 3. There's eyewitness testimony that Joe Biden joined multiple phone calls and had conversations that resulted in cars and millions of dollars being given to Hunter Biden and his son's business partners. 4. Hunter Biden implicated his dad in conversations with CCP officials, with whom he was attempting to do business. A WhatsApp message from Hunter in 2017, obtained by the IRS, stated "I am sitting here with my father and we would like to understand why the commitment made has not been fulfilled." This was in regards to a $100,000 payment to Hunter from a suspected CCP official and businessman. 5. The White House story on this subject has changed multiple times, which only increases suspicions. First, they claimed that Joe Biden had no knowledge whatsoever of Hunter Biden's business dealings. And now, after facts have emerged that expose the obvious lie of their original claim, they are saying that Joe Biden was not involved in Hunter Biden's business. This rapid about-face in the White House's response raises serious concerns. An impeachment inquiry will allow access to more documents that could highlight corruption or pay-for-play. It will provide the apex of investigative authority and is necessary for the House to perform proper oversight. This inquiry will help House Republicans to get the facts. If you have nothing to hide, you shouldn't oppose a fact-finding mission. I will keep you updated as this inquiry proceeds. | | | | | | | | BIDEN IS TRYING TO STOP MILLIONS OF AMERICANS FROM RECEIVING SHORT-TERM HEALTH INSURANCE | == | == | | | Here's one for the ages. The President who accuses Republicans of trying to take away health care access is limiting your access to short-term health plans. This is part two of the great, "if you like your plan, you can keep your plan" lie. In 2018, the Trump Administration expanded plan offerings by removing unnecessary federal requirements around short-term health insurance. The idea is simple: if you need comprehensive long-term coverage, you get comprehensive long-term coverage. If you need short-term insurance - maybe you're between plans or young and healthy - get short-term insurance. It's grounded in the principle of choice. Biden doesn't like the concept of short-term coverage, and claims that he is protecting the consumer. But while he thinks he knows better than you, his policy ignores some really important facts: We will have more uninsured people without these plans. Based on an average of projections from the Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services Office of the Actuary, the Congressional Budget Office, the Center for Health Economy, the Urban Institute, and the Commonwealth Fund, the current proposed changes to the 2018 rule will likely leave millions of Americans uninsured. In addition, the regulatory impact analysis concedes that spending will increase. So, we're spending more money to insure fewer people? That's backwards. Effectively, this will eliminate a key protection for people with preexisting conditions. It would mean that a person who gets sick during the coverage period will lose insurance protection when that coverage period ends. Why? Biden's proposal would destroy the current 1 year coverage timeframe by limiting the short-term insurance to 3 months with a single 1 month renewal. This would also impact a person that is unemployed for more than 3 months. The current regulation offers coverage at lower premiums, and the Biden policy would increase premiums and cost to the taxpayer. The non-partisan U.S. CBO == that these short-term plans often "have lower deductibles or wider provider networks than plans in the fully regulated nongroup market" at premiums "as much as 60 percent lower than premiums for the lowest-cost bronze plan." Short-term plans strengthen the market. Some individuals who lose short-term coverage will choose Affordable Care Act coverage instead, where they will face substantially higher premiums, narrower networks and higher cost-sharing. How do we know this? Last year == collected by insurers for their exchange plans came not from the people enrolled in the plan but from the federal government's subsidies - a reflection of rising costs. Expect federal spending of your taxpayer dollars to go up. Let me spell it out in simple terms. For 10 months out of the year, people cannot buy ACA plans, and the Biden Administration's solution is to punish people that don't purchase comprehensive coverage. Everyone has unique needs, and the last thing we should be doing is narrowing the number of plan options for all Americans. body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

It wasn’t just a Hot Labor Summer — workers across the country are
continuing to keep up the fight for better working conditions, pay, and
benefits.

Today, United Auto Workers (UAW) announced they’re officially going on
strike!

UAW represents more than 140,000 workers at the Big 3 automakers in
Detroit: GM, Ford, and Stellantis (formerly known as Fiat Chrysler).

This is the first time in history that UAW are going on strike against all
three motor companies at the same time, putting major pressure on these
corporations to deliver on workers’ demands.

Right now, far too many auto workers under UAW are working 60, 70, and 80
hours per week just to get by. That’s why UAW is calling for a four-day
workweek for 40 hours of pay — something they pushed for all the way back
in the 1930s and 1940s — in addition to pay raises and cost of living
adjustments.

Somehow it’s 2023 and thousands of workers are still working 10-12 hour
days on assembly lines, putting their health and safety at risk while
barely making ends meet at home. This strike isn’t just for the workers at
UAW; it’s for all of us.

Justice Democrats proudly stands in solidarity with UAW as they embark on
this historic strike: [ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/138008?t=1001&akid=30868%2E1203867%2ESRBqeu ]join us and show your support on social media
with the hashtag #StandUpUAW.

This news further proves that the labor movement is alive and well, and
the diverse working people across our country aren’t going to give up
until we get what we deserve.

In solidarity,

Justice Democrats

Friends,
**FIRST:** Republicans abused their power to create heavily gerrymandered maps in Wisconsin that would virtually guarantee they could win a supermajority in the legislature.
**THEN:** Justice Janet Protasiewicz was elected by the people to be on the Wisconsin Supreme Court, and when she was sworn in, Republicans immediately began plotting to impeach her so she couldn't overturn those unjust maps.
**NOW:** The GOP is taking their power grab even further to prevent fair elections. They plan on firing Wisconsin’s **nonpartisan** Elections Commission Administrator, Meagan Wolf.
Why? After President Biden defeated Trump by 21,000 votes in 2020, conspiracy theorists have thrown around false claims that Wolfe rigged the 2020 election in favor of President Joe Biden. These conspiracy theorists have harassed her nonstop and are calling for her to be fired and even arrested.
And some Republican state senators are listening, vowing to oust her before the 2024 presidential election in an effort to keep their power.
These baseless accusations are a thinly veiled effort for the GOP to abuse their power once again in their neverending quest for political gain and power.
We cannot continue to let this stand. We must take back the legislative majority in Wisconsin and put an end to these undemocratic stunts.

| | The House was back in session this week, but it wasn't business as usual. **Kevin McCarthy is focused on impeaching President Biden and bending to the demands of the most radical Republicans in Congress instead of working to avoid a government shutdown in****15 ****days.** Each day, their inability to lead brings us closer to another catastrophic self-inflicted wound. **This is a serious situation with potentially dire consequences for millions of Americans**. A government shutdown could:
* Undermine our disaster preparedness by halting FEMA aid;
* Disrupt Small Business Administration and Federal Housing Administration lending;
* Further delay existing veterans' disability claims and efforts to reduce the backlog;
* Delay tax refunds;
* Kick thousands of kids out of Head Start and other federally-supported child care services;
* Delay Food and Drug Administration approvals of medical products, devices, & drugs;
* Stop permitting, environmental, and other reviews for transportation and energy projects all over the country; and
* Furlough thousands of non-essential federal employees while forcing essential federal workers to report to work without pay or the guarantee to be paid back for time lost.

These extremist Republicans have lost sight of our sacred duty. For them, this is just another partisan game. Some even seem excited at the prospect of a government shutdown. **It's time to stop toying with people's livelihoods.** We, as members of Congress, are here to improve the lives of the people who elected us and to safeguard our democracy. **I hope Speaker McCarthy reflects upon his oath of office and puts the needs of our country ahead of partisan politics and his position as Speaker.** If he does so, I am confident we will be able to find a bipartisan solution together. I'm ready to get to work. More soon, _Andy_ |

name: Team AOC
subject: What’s going on with the UAW strike?
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
Hot labor summer continues.
#
At 11:59 PM last night, the United Auto Workers contract expired with their employers at the ‘Big 3’ — Ford, General Motors, and Stellantis — who refused to meet the demands of workers negotiating for better pay and working conditions for nearly 150,000 people across the country.
The Big 3 have netted nearly a quarter trillion dollars in profit over the last decade. On average, the Big 3 CEOs have given themselves raises of 40%, but **UAW wages have only increased by 6%.**
Contract negotiations are still underway, but **the UAW are officially on strike at all 3 automakers for the first time in the union’s history.**
**[The time to stand with United Auto Workers is now. Moral and political support is truly significant. One of the best ways to do that is to join the picket line and sign the UAW petition today →](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/20926?t=1&akid=4989%2E2526796%2EY65KIV)**
**[Sign the petition](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/20926?t=2&akid=4989%2E2526796%2EY65KIV)**
Here’s a little background on how we got here, what’s happening now, and what could be next:
* **What UAW members are asking for in the new contracts:** to start with, a 40% increase in pay – in line with the average salary growth of top executives at the Big 3. Other proposals include improved retiree benefits, cost of living adjustments, and protections for part-time and temporary workers.
* Each of the Big 3 are negotiating with UAW separately. Each has **only agreed to a 20% wage increase — or half of the 40% proposal** — and each has flat out rejected many of the other proposals, including the end of a tiered wage system and restoration of pensions.
* **The UAW started a limited ‘stand up strike’ last night with the goal of increasing pressure on the contract negotiations.** About 13,000 UAW union members walked off the job at 3 strategic locations when the contract expired last night: a Ford assembly plant in Wayne, MI that makes Ranger trucks and Bronco SUV’s; a General Motors plant in Wentzville, MO that makes Chevrolet trucks and Express vans; and a Stellantis plant in Toledo, OH that builds Jeep Wranglers and Gladiators.
* **The strikes will broaden to all 150,000 autoworkers if negotiations do not improve.** An immediate increase on car prices is not expected, but the union is responsible for making over half of the light vehicles built in the U.S. — so a longer strike could impact suppliers and other businesses, given the auto industry’s role in national manufacturing.

"We're living in a time of stunning inequality throughout our society," UAW President Shawn Fain said. "We're living in a time where our industry is undergoing massive transformations, and we're living in a time where our labor movement is redefining itself."
**Team AOC stands in solidarity with the United Auto Workers, both for the good of the union and for the working class.**
[**Show your solidarity and sign the United Auto Workers petition today →** ](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/20926?t=3&akid=4989%2E2526796%2EY65KIV)
**[Sign the petition](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/20926?t=4&akid=4989%2E2526796%2EY65KIV)**
In solidarity,
Team AOC

Peter, Have you seen New Mexico Governor Michelle Lujan Grisham’s insane gun ban? She used a “public health emergency” to ban open and concealed carry by decree. Let’s be clear: _Her action is clearly unconstitutional._

But that’s not even the worst part... it won’t actually stop the violence.

Here’s a pro tip, Governor: _**Criminals don’t obey firearm ban executive orders.**_

Once again, liberals throw the Constitution out the window to erase the freedoms of law-abiding citizens in the name of “safety,” all while leaving us even less safe.
---
[**> > STAND UP FOR YOUR FREEDOMS <<**](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=5d78dae0568144efb4ab6ea8ed22d24a&_e=ooAUe065X5rukAnT5nKHfignurUMmy2ehQszlQwAkG-jB-kJxVC1hDUebDPO_uHSD003gFNIhahP__WaJ-RRLGfxinULMfNm8iuzBiJK8S9ZEA-4MIFi7pFQHxJy6K-cjuPU2uXzfxZZfzfuX-4gkSyy3JsjBYjnxGeBWQC7q3Y7vk5TFcKg_gyii2cpUGBGuyjMYZVy1h-XpMVUidBxGA2UNVQ18ZF9ait8o__m7khMBW9whbp7-FuUdSVGynPH3xcMqqTTI2DwgerHdqzuP_dNGzhjgigA_79-ZNI418o9Il5Hox1XQrpDUMC8EHHvK5zIYeJf6xuzc0i82uhNzfrqvVefkR38NODVm2qL7xk-jPwgFdYXze0827kqOSLslr0hkTIH1OGPKFU2yy9pqw%3D%3D)

**As Attorney General, I’m committed to defending both your freedoms AND your safety.**

**_[That’s why we go after criminals in Virginia, not our citizens’ Second Amendment rights.](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=5d78dae0568144efb4ab6ea8ed22d24a&_e=ooAUe065X5rukAnT5nKHfignurUMmy2ehQszlQwAkG-jB-kJxVC1hDUebDPO_uHSD003gFNIhahP__WaJ-RRLGfxinULMfNm8iuzBiJK8S9ZEA-4MIFi7pFQHxJy6K-cjuPU2uXzfxZZfzfuX-4gkSyy3JsjBYjnxGeBWQC7q3Y7vk5TFcKg_gyii2cpUGBGuyjMYZVy1h-XpMVUidBxGA2UNVQ18ZF9ait8o__m7kiptY2cINiE2cTjz8r0-ag2Pk0XYXJVi3Gp8pUWg-V8Ay0TL9Xdz_RDJcLJOPbASnC6nR4b8t3ZpB5GNxzinKqJNFkyWXATKk-DtBG5II1tUp1OHnQ3wDrTE2Qjl9j81n3KT2ESkHWD4ifNjQYRCkFqG_PkHl4o2IFNxFsgwhVOAg%3D%3D "That’s why we go after criminals in Virginia, not our citizens’ Second Amendment rights.")_ **

And it’s why it’s so urgent that we have an Attorney General in office who does the hard work of restoring public order instead of political grandstanding.

**Peter, your support allows me to continue fighting for law and order in Virginia.** That means:
* protecting your constitutional rights,
* standing up to woke prosecutors,
* and making sure law enforcement has the funding they need.

I’ll never stop fighting for you. But we must be ready for the Michelle Lujan Grishams of the world who want to shred the Constitution to push their disastrous agendas.

**That’s why I’m asking for your help today, Peter. Will you stand up for your freedom AND your safety with me?**

* * *
Hey Peter, a lot of people wonder about my journey and why I decided to run for governor. It's been a wild ride, so here are a few memories that sum it up:

July 2, 2001

The day I took the oath of office as the 23-year-old mayor of Nettleton. Green as a gourd, I was excited to get to work. I can’t thank the people of my hometown enough for placing their trust in me all those years ago.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/69796159/427326649/974620941?refcode=ea.164cacb3-f153-ee11-9937-00224832e811&ms=ea.164cacb3-f153-ee11-9937-00224832e811&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDMzMTAiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMTY0Y2FjYjMtZjE1My1lZTExLTk5MzctMDAyMjQ4MzJlODExIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=WONB6TPqi-a-Henk1okaY_rLJQsQQjPmuAB3B_NylLk=)
November 7, 2007

At the young age of 30, I became the youngest Public Service Commissioner ever elected in Mississippi history. And I made things happen. I’ve opened up meetings that had been closed to the public for decades, brought high-speed internet to some of the most remote parts of Mississippi, put people back to work, and saved taxpayers over 6 billion dollars.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/69796160/427326657/974620941?refcode=ea.164cacb3-f153-ee11-9937-00224832e811&ms=ea.164cacb3-f153-ee11-9937-00224832e811&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDMzMTAiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMTY0Y2FjYjMtZjE1My1lZTExLTk5MzctMDAyMjQ4MzJlODExIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=WONB6TPqi-a-Henk1okaY_rLJQsQQjPmuAB3B_NylLk=)
January 12, 2023

The day I launched my campaign for governor in Mississippi. I couldn’t be more grateful to have overwhelming support from voters and local community members across our great state. On day one of this campaign, it was clear to me that we could build a movement strong enough to defeat the odds.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/69796161/427326663/974620941?refcode=ea.164cacb3-f153-ee11-9937-00224832e811&ms=ea.164cacb3-f153-ee11-9937-00224832e811&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDMzMTAiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMTY0Y2FjYjMtZjE1My1lZTExLTk5MzctMDAyMjQ4MzJlODExIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=WONB6TPqi-a-Henk1okaY_rLJQsQQjPmuAB3B_NylLk=)
August 8, 2023

The night I became the official Democratic Nominee for the Magnolia state. clean_body: Take a trip down memory lane with me. | = | = Hey Peter, a lot of people wonder about my journey and why I decided to run for governor. It's been a wild ride, so here are a few memories that sum it up: July 2, 2001 The day I took the oath of office as the 23-year-old mayor of Nettleton. Green as a gourd, I was excited to get to work. I can’t thank the people of my hometown enough for placing their trust in me all those years ago. = November 7, 2007 At the young age of 30, I became the youngest Public Service Commissioner ever elected in Mississippi history. And I made things happen. I’ve opened up meetings that had been closed to the public for decades, brought high-speed internet to some of the most remote parts of Mississippi, put people back to work, and saved taxpayers over 6 billion dollars. = January 12, 2023 The day I launched my campaign for governor in Mississippi. I couldn’t be more grateful to have overwhelming support from voters and local community members across our great state. On day one of this campaign, it was clear to me that we could build a movement strong enough to defeat the odds. = August 8, 2023 The night I became the official Democratic Nominee for the Magnolia state. I couldn’t have done it without folks like you — who’ve been in my corner from the start of this journey — to thank for our Primary Election success. I knew at that moment that this wasn’t your ordinary campaign. This was a real movement for change. = November 7, 2023 In less than two months, Mississippi will face one of the most competitive gubernatorial elections in decades. And it’s one of the toughest challenges I have yet to face. It’s not easy to take on a well-funded, bought-and-paid-for politician like Tate Reeves. **GET TO KNOW VIVEK:** Vivek is an American entrepreneur, political and cultural thought leader, and New York Times bestselling author of **_Woke, Inc.: Inside Corporate America's Social Justice Scam_** , along with his second book, **_Nation of Victims: Identity Politics, the Death of Merit, and the Path Back to Excellence_**.

He has been a prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do through the front door under the Constitution.

Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." This advice set the course for his life: an accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. He went on to graduate summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund, then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where his team developed five drugs that went on to become FDA-approved.

In 2022, he founded Strive Asset Management, an Ohio-based firm, that takes direct aim at asset managers like BlackRock, State Street, Vanguard and others for their fiduciary breach of duty to maximize the wealth of their clients for Wokeism. Strive's mission is to restore the voices of everyday citizens in the American economy by leading companies to focus on excellence over politics.
