He has been a prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do through the front door under the Constitution. Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." When was the last time someone told you that New Mexicans are a rich people? Likely, never.

But we are. In New Mexico, we are blessed with a rich and diverse tapestry of history, culture, and tradition that comes to life in the people and landscapes we call home. It’s with the backdrop of our public lands and the jagged, sun-kissed peaks of the Organ Mountains that many important parts of Hispanic history — as well as our nation’s history — have been written here.

From the ancient Mogollons who set up camps along the Rio Grande river over 1,000 years ago to the first 33 Mexican settlers who founded the Doña Ana Bend Colony, the descendants of our Native and Spanish ancestors — us — are now the keepers of these lands and our collective history.

This mes nacional de la herencia hispana (National Hispanic Heritage Month) we honor those who came before us — and celebrate the continuation of our traditions and culture now in the 21st century.

**As a first-generation Mexican-American who grew up on both sides of the border, I know how important it is that our stories are told in the halls of power, and I’m proud to help lead the Congressional Hispanic Caucus.**

[Unfortunately, my time in Congress could be cut short. I only flipped this seat blue in 2022 with 50.3% of the vote. Gabe won the most competitive Democratic seat in Congress in 2022, and is running to be a champion for working families and build an economy that benefits everyone. If you’d like to unsubscribe, | | When was the last time someone told you that New Mexicans are a rich people? Likely, never. But we are. In New Mexico, we are blessed with a rich and diverse tapestry of history, culture, and tradition that comes to life in the people and landscapes we call home. It’s with the backdrop of our public lands and the jagged, sun-kissed peaks of the Organ Mountains that many important parts of Hispanic history — as well as our nation’s history — have been written here. From the ancient Mogollons who set up camps along the Rio Grande river over 1,000 years ago to the first 33 Mexican settlers who founded the Doña Ana Bend Colony, the descendants of our Native and Spanish ancestors — us — are now the keepers of these lands and our collective history. This mes nacional de la herencia hispana (National Hispanic Heritage Month) we honor those who came before us — and celebrate the continuation of our traditions and culture now in the 21st century. Peter,

This past midnight, the United Auto Workers walked off the job as management failed to offer fairer wages after a protracted negotiation.

This is personal to me – to all of us in IL-17, where more than 10,000 UAW workers call this district home.

**I stand in solidarity with our striking auto workers.**

In IL-17 and around our country, high-quality union jobs gave workers a path to the middle class.

**But today, as companies are raking in record profits, workers' benefits have been roundly stripped.**

**And wages haven’t just stagnated, they’ve flatlined: The average auto worker’s salary has declined by 40 percent over the past two decades.**

Something has to give.

This isn’t for just this moment, but for auto workers to ensure they and other workers going forward can simply receive a fair share.

Like all of you, I hope this strike is settled quickly, but only if the workers can get the modest, fair wages they’re asking for. **And I’ve got their back for as long as it takes.**

Eric

# [](https://act.losecruzpac.com/go/128?t=1&akid=92%2E623276%2E9d3c2j)

* _More than_ $5,000 dollars raised that came from;
* 320+ individual contributions and;
* Our average donation was _just_ $17.08.

Now, you may be wondering why we’re talking about _last month’s_ fundraising.
Analyzing our fundraising data from the most recent month allows us to make strategic decisions for the future to build a sustainable grassroots campaign needed to Lose Cruz next year.
**We know that the road to winning won't be easy.** That's why it's _**critical**_ that we meet or exceed our fundraising goals so our movement amasses the resources it needs to win. If we fall short, we may have to consider the (incredibly scary) possibility of _another_ six years of this guy reading us Dr. Seuss. 🤢

Friend,
As Keith's campaign manager, part of my job is keeping you up-to-date on all things campaign related – including the official opponent in this race. And I'll be honest, I've noticed a few red flags.
Before I share my thoughts, Keith's campaign is relying on early support from folks like you to be able to face Jim Banks next November – to spread the word, will you chip in toward essential campaign materials like yard signs, mailers, and supplies for our volunteers? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/potts-email?refcode=20230915_em_fr_b1_SCM_3090]
CHIP IN TODAY [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/potts-email?refcode=20230915_em_fr_b1_SCM_3090]
I want to be as honest with you as possible, so here are just a few things you should know about GOP-endorsed Jim Banks:
🚩 He's committed to limiting our freedoms – freedom to choose, to live safely, to vote.
🚩 He's led the attack on Social Security, indifferent about the devastating impact it would have on Hoosiers across the state.
🚩 He's shown more commitment to his party than to his people, going so far as to call the investigation into the attack on the Capitol on January 6 "a political witch hunt" .
This last one is less surprising, Friend – just this week, Banks came out in support of the far-right's recent impeachment inquiry against President Biden, calling him the "most corrupt President to ever live in the White House."
Friend, it's obvious we need a different kind of leader in Washington, and Keith is working hard to be a strong voice for our community.
As a member of the Indy City County Council, he's seen the positive impact government can have if their focus remains on delivering solutions for the people. And he's ready to bring that mindset to DC.
But if we're going to show Jim Banks and the GOP the strength of people-first, people-funded campaigns like Keith's, we're relying on folks like you to close the fundraising gap. Please, Friend, will you make a donation of any amount today? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/potts-email?refcode=20230915_em_fr_b1_SCM_3090]
DONATE [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/potts-email?refcode=20230915_em_fr_b1_SCM_3090]
Thank you,
Sam
Keith Potts was first elected in 2019 to represent District 2 on the Indianapolis City-County Council.

Keith’s political work has been centered on issue-based campaigns and progressive candidates, with a particular focus on protecting women’s rights, LGBTQ+ rights, and the environment.
He is an arts advocate, having graduated in 2012 from the Boston Conservatory of Music with a Bachelor of Fine Arts degree. He works with local non-profit arts organizations, teaching after-school music classes, directing, and performing with organizations like the Phoenix Theatre, Indy Shakes, Indianapolis Chamber Orchestra, Actors Theatre of Indiana, and Civic Theatre. Keith currently lives on the north side of Indianapolis with his husband, Dr. Bryan Dodd, and their rescue dog, Mak.

name: Courier Newsroom Team
subject: No paywalls, no subscription fees. Just honest journalism.
body:
Courier provides reliable news coverage in “news deserts” across the country, with no paywalls or subscription fees.
# [](https://act.couriernewsroom.com/go/83?t=1&akid=1566%2E120351%2EGcb5yV)
Courier provides reliable news coverage in "news deserts" across the country, with no paywalls or subscription fees. Instead, we rely on contributions from supporters like you. **[With our mid-month fundraising deadline approaching, can you pitch in anything you can to help us reach our goal of raising $7,500 by midnight tonight? Thank you for your support.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-courier-20230915?refcode=em20230915&amount=&refcode2=1566_120351_Gcb5yV&akid=1566%2E120351%2EGcb5yV)
---
Peter,
**The mainstream media is failing.** By prioritizing profits and the illusion of “balance,” the public is losing trust in one of democracy’s most important institutions. To make matters worse, by chasing clicks and rushing to present “both sides of the story,” many media organizations consequently provide oxygen to right-wing bad actors and their efforts to spread misinformation.
It’s how Donald Trump became President. It’s how climate change denialism became mainstream. It’s how anti-vaccine propaganda spread to every corner of the Internet.
We could go on and on, but here’s the good news:
**Courier was founded as a bold response to these failures. We don’t chase profit and will never compromise our values in our reporting.**
**Our mission is to bring reliable, trustworthy news to the communities that need it most.** We call out misinformation in real time, by providing context and factual reporting in the spaces where misinformation thrives.
Currently, we’re operating in nine states, but we want to keep expanding! By providing credible, fact-based coverage in battleground states like Arizona, Pennsylvania, Wisconsin, Michigan, Virginia, Florida, Iowa, North Carolina, and Nevada, we can keep voters in these key states informed as they head to the ballot box next year.
**And we do it _without_ paywalls or subscription fees in order to make our reporting as accessible as possible.**
But running a growing network of newsrooms doesn’t come cheap, and without the revenue stream provided by subscription fees, we rely on contributions from donors like you to sustain our operations. Today we’re approaching our mid-month fundraising deadline for the month of September, so we’re reaching out to ask for your help.
**[If you want to support Courier's mission of providing accessible, reliable, honest journalism that's committed to combating misinformation, please consider pitching in anything you can so we can meet our goal of raising $7,500 by midnight. We truly can't do it without you.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-courier-20230915?refcode=em20230915&amount=&refcode2=1566_120351_Gcb5yV&akid=1566%2E120351%2EGcb5yV)
**[Donate now ➡️](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-courier-20230915?refcode=em20230915&amount=5&refcode2=1566_120351_Gcb5yV&akid=1566%2E120351%2EGcb5yV)**
Thank you, Peter.

Courier provides reliable news coverage in "news deserts" across the country, with no paywalls or subscription fees. Instead, we rely on contributions from supporters like you. Peter, The mainstream media is failing. By prioritizing profits and the illusion of “balance,” the public is losing trust in one of democracy’s most important institutions. To make matters worse, by chasing clicks and rushing to present “both sides of the story,” many media organizations consequently provide oxygen to right-wing bad actors and their efforts to spread misinformation. It’s how Donald Trump became President. It’s how climate change denialism became mainstream. It’s how anti-vaccine propaganda spread to every corner of the Internet. We could go on and on, but here’s the good news: Courier was founded as a bold response to these failures. We don’t chase profit and will never compromise our values in our reporting. Our mission is to bring reliable, trustworthy news to the communities that need it most. We call out misinformation in real time, by providing context and factual reporting in the spaces where misinformation thrives. Currently, we’re operating in nine states, but we want to keep expanding! By providing credible, fact-based coverage in battleground states like Arizona, Pennsylvania, Wisconsin, Michigan, Virginia, Florida, Iowa, North Carolina, and Nevada, we can keep voters in these key states informed as they head to the ballot box next year. And we do it without paywalls or subscription fees in order to make our reporting as accessible as possible. But running a growing network of newsrooms doesn’t come cheap, and without the revenue stream provided by subscription fees, we rely on contributions from donors like you to sustain our operations. Today we’re approaching our mid-month fundraising deadline for the month of September, so we’re reaching out to ask for your help. Thank you, Peter. Friend – Happy Hispanic Heritage Month!

Over the next month, I hope you’ll join me in celebrating and uplifting the endless contributions made by the Hispanic community to our nation and culture.

**As a proud Latina woman, I reflect on my heritage quite often.** I think about my father, Roberto, and his journey here to the United States – a familiar, harrowing journey made by millions of other Latinos across the country.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/69798963/427336153/-796242365?refcode=em_fr_2023.09.15_b1_as_all-nd&amount=10&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85Mzg4OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4Y2Q2ZGRkOS1mNjUzLWVlMTEtOTkzNy0wMDIyNDgzMmU4MTEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=rezTG323p0w3vdk4JVO1hO-COa0Z48vDU1oPnh9poIM=) _My father, Roberto._ My dad immigrated from Mexico in 1950. Whenever he wasn’t in school, he worked in the fields alongside my grandparents, picking tomatoes and cotton. After a few years of high school, my dad marched down to the local recruiting office and signed up to join the U.S. Marine Corps. He served two tours in Vietnam and, in exchange for his service, received his U.S. citizenship.

Friend, Let’s have workers’ backs! I grew up in a union household and have seen the power of the UAW fighting for workers’ rights and wages. Today, 150,000 UAW workers have gone on strike, demanding a fair contract. And the Big Three automakers can afford it. **Over the last 5 years, Ford, General Motors, and Stellantis (formerly Chrysler) raked in $250 billion in profits; and they expect another $32 billion in profits this year.** 1 **At the same time, CEOs at the Big Three have seen their own salaries skyrocket by 40% or more.** And, the Big Three have showered wealthy shareholders with tens of billions of dollars in dividend payments while spending billions more on stock buybacks to further enrich their investors.2 The UAW workers are demanding a percentage wage increase equal to that of the CEOs, a renewal of their cost-of-living adjustments (COLA), which they forfeited during the 2008 economic recession to keep the automakers afloat, and an end to the two-tiered hiring system that pays many workers less than their peers while doing the same job. [**With UAW workers on strike, let’s show massive public support for workers in the face of outrageous corporate greed. And, the Big Three have showered wealthy shareholders with tens of billions of dollars in dividend payments while spending billions more on stock buybacks to further enrich their investors.2 The UAW workers are demanding a percentage wage increase equal to that of the CEOs, a renewal of their cost-of-living adjustments (COLA), which they forfeited during the 2008 economic recession to keep the automakers afloat, and an end to the two-tiered hiring system that pays many workers less than their peers while doing the same job. | If you’re not on Twitter, there’s still something you can do. | | On September 15, 1963, members of the Klu Klux Klan planted 19 sticks of dynamite next to the stairwell of a church in Birmingham, Alabama — and four little girls lost their lives:

**_Denise McNair, Cynthia Wesley, Carole Robertson, and Addie Mae Collins._**

Today, 60 years later, we take time to honor their lives and legacy.

It was this heinous attack that raised our nation’s collective consciousness to finally pass the _Civil Rights Act of 1964_ and the _Voting Rights Act of 1965_. It was a turning point in our history but it came at a great cost.

It’s hard not to see the parallels to today with political leaders stoking violence through hateful rhetoric and an effort to whitewash America’s racist history.

That’s why, here at The Collective PAC, we are choosing not only to remember these four girls as heroes of the Civil Rights movement but we are also using this day to find renewed strength to keep fighting for equal rights and equal representation.

For Denise, Cynthia, Carole, and Addie.

— The Collective PAC

Today, 60 years later, we take time to honor their lives and legacy. It was this heinous attack that raised our nation’s collective consciousness to finally pass the Civil Rights Act of 1964 and the Voting Rights Act of 1965. **MEMORANDUM**
TO: The AOTL Grassroots Supporters
FROM: John Bisognano, President
DATE: September 15th, 2023
RE: Redistricting Showdown - Our Stand Against Gerrymandering
Team,
As we gear up for the challenges ahead, I'm reaching out to you, the backbone of our movement, with a call to action. Your steadfast support has been instrumental in our fight for fair representation, but our work is far from over.
[**If you don’t have time to read the full memo right now but would still like to support All On The Line’s mobilization efforts, you can do so by clicking here.**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/69800622/427341450/-2038301480?refcode=20230915_AOTL_F_Rdup_RedLite&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk2IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjJhYzcyODAwLWZiNTMtZWUxMS05OTM3LTAwMjI0ODMyZTgxMSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=gRQDE2LnqSKsDfv5kws_dN35SLcZeLu82_fJKSBcPpY=)
**Fighting for Fair Representation in Florida**
At the start of September, a Florida trial court made a landmark decision, deeming the state's congressional map in violation of the Florida Constitution’s Fair Districts Amendment. This verdict is a significant stride towards fair representation. It reaffirms the commitment to a democracy that respects every voice.
**Alabama’s Defiance and Upholding the Rule of Law**
In Alabama, a federal district court ordered the redrawing of the state's congressional map and the US Supreme Court agreed, emphasizing the need for fairness and yet, the state legislature refused to comply. It's disheartening to witness the resistance against this directive. We must stand united in upholding the rule of law, and ensuring that every community, regardless of its composition, is justly represented.

Hey there, Peter — Jirair for Congress here. I wanted to share a special moment from my week with you.

I have a friend named Dayo who immigrated to this country from Nigeria. He came here to seek refuge and a better life where he knows his rights are protected and is free to love who he wants to love. Do you want to know one of the first things he did? He immediately donated to my campaign for Congress because he believes in my fight to protect the American Dream for all.

My family’s story is not all that different from Dayo’s. My grandparents and parents immigrated to the United States from Armenia and Lebanon to build a better life for future generations. They worked hard and thanks to their work, I went on to attend UCLA and became a public health doctor.

Over the past few decades, I’ve used my education and professional experience to advocate for marginalized communities and through that work I’ve learned that the American dream isn’t so easily attainable. Inflation is high, affordable housing is hard to find, many of our neighbors don’t have access to healthcare, childcare, or quality education.

**I stepped up to run for Congress because as someone born and raised in this diverse district, I understand the unique challenges that so many of our neighbors are facing.** That’s why hearing about Dayo’s belief in me and our movement was so encouraging.

With more than 14 other candidates in this crowded primary, these next few weeks will be critical. I need to raise as much money as possible and I can’t do that without your help. Friend, I am asking for your support in my efforts as a member of the RNC's Youth Advisory Council, will you chip in?
| | | | [](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001XFm2Ywo2Kl0Ph-xJseVlvSQJLdzUiBrZ_y2_8ua_DFjjqEob60aUVKOCuaWDpwtnoXOLoCvMlImNJy5xnSBzSXT9G0Y5a2vNCyvZNO8lxIItEUpc22NdX4xVzf6zj_b2qyx3gCCNuFYvSSFPDzxzgENssHndu-4S9qLcEmphG-9pnE_rF-vshnDbvJVLryBR&c=ail6scFgpa9x2J1uE0ViNe6T0N3oCODlHLN-BeZfsTS0SbTeKxcfCw==&ch=kZNL4TrfTkUV2I65-5PHzQ0hdjiog_8g2RXqHhe2r3H-FzAe3UK78g==)
---

| Friend,
If you saw my recent report on the RNC Summer Meeting you also saw that the next Youth Advisory Council Meeting has been scheduled for this Monday, September 18th in Washington, DC.
This position on the council is completely volunteer and with it comes a high degree of cost to get back and fourth to the meetings around the country.
With that being said, at 19 years old it is hard to afford the travel cost associated with this role. However, with your support I can ensure that the voices of the grass roots that I represent are heard at the council meetings and RNC meetings in the Spring, Summer and Winter.
The Youth Advisory Council is playing a major role in the 2024 Presidential Race, starting with the roll out of the Bank Your Vote initiative and now helping guide the messaging for the eventual Republican Presidential Nominee in regards to Gen Z and Millennial outreach.
It is the honor of a lifetime to be a part of the inaugural Youth Advisory Council and with your support I can continue to have an impact on the direction that the Republican National Committee is taking when it comes to engaging and winning over my generation.
I am humbly asking for your support in this effort to save my generation and win big in 2024.
---

---
| | [Support My Efforts on Behalf of The Next Generation!](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001XFm2Ywo2Kl0Ph-xJseVlvSQJLdzUiBrZ_y2_8ua_DFjjqEob60aUVKOCuaWDpwtnoXOLoCvMlImNJy5xnSBzSXT9G0Y5a2vNCyvZNO8lxIItEUpc22NdX4xVzf6zj_b2qyx3gCCNuFYvSSFPDzxzgENssHndu-4S9qLcEmphG-9pnE_rF-vshnDbvJVLryBR&c=ail6scFgpa9x2J1uE0ViNe6T0N3oCODlHLN-BeZfsTS0SbTeKxcfCw==&ch=kZNL4TrfTkUV2I65-5PHzQ0hdjiog_8g2RXqHhe2r3H-FzAe3UK78g==)
---
| We all understand the disastrous impact of Bidenomics on all of us and I would like to say that unless you are financially able, please do not contribute to this effort.
I am humbly asking for your support to ensure I can give you my all on the Youth Advisory Council and you have my word that I will be dedicated to this movement as long as I am asked to serve on your behalf.
I hope that I can count on your support and I look forward to traveling to Washington next week to meet with my fellow members and Chairwoman McDaniel at RNC Head Quarters on Capitol Hill.
Grateful for your support and in service to you,
---

| | Rules for thee, but not for me. Massachusetts Governor Maura Healey, another super-duper liberal, is calling an audible and [deploying the National Guard](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=7f91129a037244d8be1b2813e5be8154&_e=ww-WaBr5H4mHlp6F2x0AZUH-zeFeWHhf9DTuxJjDTNnXM1eSMgXp2APKt7oXNT-alMVeUt_zto20V1sd4rey_fUrMPYutSYJLKYL4JKx39IELojPamBpowfgwBXpr8RWQ6jLRIrRjvLRYj4KIAQAb_esaxGuHbUXN2-DAm3M_yFGhZxuhZ1zXEgwUZxiy4EeSbxDyTLVrnKdS0Z5hejG7yu3Dpmb44dXPlLcP1eUiD2C_rcAGrMBop-BSjMPNcvty_B0obQhIEtVCetw6TH4X9MW2-DHCTt0wKSWS2TFJVI-RglsiLZ_4yO8h_cStLEmeSC9RLC2uTYtMc1Vw-3h-A%3D%3D) to assist with the state’s migrant “crisis.” Sure, their shelters are bursting at the seams with 6,000 migrant families, but this is the bed Gov. Healey’s party made—and now it’s time to lie in it. Massachusetts is a “right to shelter” state that must provide emergency housing to families in need. What gets me fired up here is the outright hypocrisy and tone-deaf nature of Democrats and their “not in my yard” mentality. Six thousand migrant families are a _drop in the bucket_ compared to what our border states are dealing with. Let’s crunch the numbers... More than [1,300 migrants](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=7f91129a037244d8be1b2813e5be8154&_e=ww-WaBr5H4mHlp6F2x0AZfWXZJRYDVe0DwPVFzrwF4W8tn-j2w-7_tmTX4EErO1VP3ZV3Ba4XlU4VPwdvpJVXaa11yBgQfCG-wVC3TuD8Vwu4b7e6qIhtU_Q8Lp1xA3uwkQAowwu4-l_p9S3KU6DtwYpIZZhgoW2OQPjDR5CqAHLhJNI6uufg6qGhTLmFiI43tmFVn2Ip_EubI7orXEyRiPzNyTiY88RTfWxUAFRNF8ZyX37dAgGR8UXvBf_aGAheTNeoS7DZgoypH0VtF8OTERINqEWdGdI1lk_YdY66lz_ryZrBpLTeVtP019nF0Dh) cross the border into Arizona every single day. In Texas, the influx is so debilitating that they have bused [35,000 migrants](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=7f91129a037244d8be1b2813e5be8154&_e=ww-WaBr5H4mHlp6F2x0AZSW4KqDMgq4JJRUfdFc3hDLFdr3etZtWEx5dHgPxeetcYCmpQz33phwSgKDQ2Rj_TG9OjpT8FGQHwytzDWWs2ov2GezX0HImTRWG-BfpzgHrbyQ-UKxGpd9wdhk5mT7_ps3T4iO3tyQUQTsUUtKQ7Evw7vPzUMV3PXfyafJLOzLNyib6v6M_fw0y6yihnPw9MBWONg2H5awGTj1RYpT4XG-UR5SfHiUnj8seV6EcjuQdBDkKPhRb9MfwISe2oLuAMtZpZbJbqUerpm2VE4dcv8DTJWCtroVFJitaoab6AkdH) to sanctuary cities like New York—and rightfully so. The response? [Crocodile tears](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=7f91129a037244d8be1b2813e5be8154&_e=ww-WaBr5H4mHlp6F2x0AZeQtHCLXmwilP3EU8Ll__Wv64jFa2_w8ptuPWVIyU0Jo6TCa52ohPEugL58UjVpAoANwVOQgZeWSBm-KoL-RfL5OQR5SWkrd3dqXm__OtDKyJFTYGc_oBkqrLe-zMDEgiN3KW84Ngfymd5NxuZYLRbF5c3KDHZDwGK4L5fwitD64HTWuvsnqdFotfxHKqbLWpkSSYBxKfbv4wJGR0R8DCwVjmuXgtWpmWN2zSvGQBSuIpRNSSVqxrpaZxbbXsdaxIUbfi-CpYpV3VZQDdZ3YnoIuq53SEh1jkAyyr14kfouSpM-Rp5TuJ4kXEfD6au2-jZyo0uwJ76eeCKdrqU68mSo783BnTPyY7plC45siHm-FZIW2Of1cpZ1sEqBibWC7FoWIfRKm7fwZz05j8lXMib2LnqlUJD074QlHuWxpXW3A) from New York Mayor Eric Adams as he called Texas Governor Greg Abbott a [“madman.”](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=7f91129a037244d8be1b2813e5be8154&_e=ww-WaBr5H4mHlp6F2x0AZeQtHCLXmwilP3EU8Ll__Wv64jFa2_w8ptuPWVIyU0JonguN3Re3OZi3UPUvteQEPyPSqQLo_Q9C-8400-GUbjRAcgIqoTTe5v-yk4H513irY8BWAYigVA2vFQ1OYA7b4p3mgz8e524lOwXcxqmq26KNmJRPOdobPC7eV8kqQGBRZL4K8y433Qx7uvrNn0uDYBLY5F42MJXbIz6nduDJYyfZW31f76mQ5W9lbhf5Ey47gt8yZKVHbdORwPzBxVEEoEYEHRd7CyiuV6lDaamx7bg%3D) If I were Gov. Abbott, I’d wear that nickname with a badge of honor. _Of course_ he’s mad. Mad as hell that his state is in complete disarray because of harmful progressive policies. The leftist free-for-all circus is deteriorating the fabric of every border town community. But where is our commander-in-chief as this all comes crashing down? He’s quietly [selling off border wall materials](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=7f91129a037244d8be1b2813e5be8154&_e=ww-WaBr5H4mHlp6F2x0AZSW4KqDMgq4JJRUfdFc3hDI4-YZrJAbMM1FuIyqnGEpiLYZqOxk3t2U39M7i-du8IhikGlsgaT4sL17OIWAz8lPF_7Gv9exvFG-7rnPgymAds_0MhhUGejSfMXTcRTEEmlW3YDRJ25EvyjEF_KCrKK6o3ktxYUJGQMzdH-2MirNa5wx6D1yjrf2ojv8OTN5iGxAuk9zDK2_FG9NyKXaMYrcQ12gRSFYRchgMuZEqqYYYrC6l54xGwRZPapLFbp25FUnYJzR74WlWPhG2n_YP414%3D), wasting taxpayer money, and doubling down on his party’s destructive open-border policies. The good news is we’re doing something about it. I’m teaming up with my colleagues on the House Oversight Committee to request every last detail on this disgusting [waste and abuse](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=7f91129a037244d8be1b2813e5be8154&_e=ww-WaBr5H4mHlp6F2x0AZUH-zeFeWHhf9DTuxJjDTNlCgJ7QWYKJ5sXNFbobzQRhVVElT464OqE6SqCHiMD13ZwnVRnvUDj0rJ1esy18ymcFWWikAUDsO7ouMQlOiXEUvg96okGGKOd1r_XlJOZ1bg4NlHacR1BoNgeUWmz6Q_1_EtnT2BGizc2hKj4d_c5peOHOL65LzYYxVAGUQvIocAl5rVXfqlVctqOsxbqzIkp9x88uAs0yO9DhRKuuQ-hErksenMdE_H6jkD3TmwS_PBUxA0vatGVMsU8xfFBeMuMymueDmVDbHb7Hfv2YgXudwEEr9nvsDPs6iHajcja5ig%3D%3D). Here we are amid the worst border crisis in our nation’s history, and instead of securing our southern border with parts that already exist, he’s trying to thwart any future attempt to build—and we won’t stand for it. We will hold these dadgum double-standard Democrats accountable, even if it’s the last thing we do.

| | _Image courtesy of WATE_ Everyone deserves a second chance, and that’s exactly what they’re offering at [Focus Ministries](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=7f91129a037244d8be1b2813e5be8154&_e=ww-WaBr5H4mHlp6F2x0AZXwTv0GmjHd4ZRTAOb87rQ8cHg_Q-I-FO4dNhHYEwnIBEddkJm5fNiCnKE-kJPRzgdFmtdB9BgFstjDbZ0MtzXWHvg4y5D2onow8G5YLQKrU7F0mPxwDTGYQrB6_Hq_iSLsxgNIM0E6nGSeLlckBomPzdSniUf30Zm326dOy5bcV) in Knoxville. What looks like a regular home on East Emory Road is a place where women are rebuilding their lives. Focus Ministries is an organization that [helps women who have been in jail](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=7f91129a037244d8be1b2813e5be8154&_e=ww-WaBr5H4mHlp6F2x0AZdh_cMsYki-aw8vdqPTnwCmAE8AGlO2pD75-vtK9dWm2_JjSEU60WhZ8CL5pqhpycQj_Lb01FmwsxT8772IvqM06wLkBnDCLDhmRlNvqQqwU4Lu8ICdF5jaZAeQd2mXW4KobJm8VG5scg9G_rlgWlCrrINfrVfyrfpaVbJdAFwSv-lwXOUmNc14znMdBRT9HapQk_sPcjGSIW0DXv8BNMZkw6fLM6UMqdyoKtjJVjZFafYDcCqYA25vxTs83ZuWpjuN4qhAyawg96voGXEyTtMwOhrU4OrX5maNmFqzrwMzxin4eCxF4mZ2eZCY-3wZUYUlar9QRKOtgCY5XfWJA76M%3D) and need help getting back on track. Think of the program as one last chance. Savannah Ford, one of the program participants, was in and out of jail for drug charges and facing a long prison sentence. But she was offered a spot at Focus Ministries' Freedom House instead, and it changed her life forever. The director says every woman chooses a different path. Some are getting their CDL to drive trucks—while others are studying cosmetology or going to culinary school. But all of them have the same common goal: Find a constructive path that leads to a bright future. I am constantly amazed by the Tennessee folks who step up and find a way to help people in their most dire time of need. We are blessed to have so many organizations like Focus Ministries that are committed to making Knoxville a better place, and I’m proud to shine a bright spotlight on the critical work they do.

| Meet **Mark Walker**

Congressman Mark Walker started his career in finance and, after earning his theology degree, Walker served 16 years as a pastor. In 2014, Walker stepped away from ministry and made a successful run for the U.S. Congress defeating a host of elected politicians. In 2015, Congressman Walker became the first member in an inaugural term to be elected Chair of the Republican Study Committee (RSC) - the largest caucus in Congress with 160 members and a position previously held by Vice President Pence and Congressman Jim Jordan.

In 2018, Walker was elected as Vice Chair of the entire conference, becoming the highest rated conservative to serve in the top four leadership positions in Congress. Walker is also the last member of Congress to secure a floor vote on a balanced budget amendment and led the House on HBCU initiatives winning the United Negro College Fund President’s list award. Congressman Walker served on multiple committees and in 2019, Walker was appointed to ranking member on the Committee on Homeland Security’s Intelligence and Counter-Terrorism’s subcommittee. Walker was co-chair of the bicameral prayer caucus for five years and also won the GOP MVP award as the starting pitcher on the Republican baseball team for the annual charity game.

Congressman Walker was redistricted out of his seat and stepped away from Congress in 2021. Walker ran for U.S. Senate in 2022 and was endorsed by Senators Tim Scott and James Lankford, Gov. Mike Huckabee, Hall of Fame Coach Tony Dungy and more than 200 pastors across North Carolina. Walker is currently the president of a political consulting business called Advancing Hope USA, and advocated for the two North Carolina Supreme Court candidates and 4 North Carolina Court of Appeals candidates through his independent expenditure organization, Win the Courts during this past general election. Congressman Walker and his wife Kelly, a Family Nurse Practitioner and flight trauma specialist, have been married for thirty years and have three children.

subject: What today means to me

body:
#
Today is Rosh Hashanah – the Jewish new year! 🍎🍯

To me, this is the perfect time to reset, reflect, and get ready for a big year ahead.

Like many Jews who celebrate, my family marks this holiday by eating apples dipped in honey – a delicious toast to a happy and healthy new year.

We will listen as our rabbi blows the Shofar – a symbolic “wake up call” to bring the community together.

But this year’s celebrations feel different. Now more than ever – regardless of religion, race, or identity – we need to once again feel the warm embrace of community.

**We must make this the year we heed the call to action and move beyond the petty politics of fear and division.**

Today we decide what we leave in the past and what we take with us into the future.

So from my family to yours, we wish you a happy, healthy new year and hope that today you can recharge and get ready for the year ahead.

With gratitude,
Zak

| Dear Friend:

This is a former mother-client I represented and defended in children’s court. I put on a trial, made my argument, won, and got her entire petition and case dismissed. I work as a children’s court attorney, representing and defending parents in children’s court – vulnerable parents and families of Los Angeles County whom the government and our systems have failed to support. **Every day, I’m in children’s court fighting to keep families together, and don’t have the time and resources of the corporate-backed incumbent to do photo-ops and virtue signaling.** And instead of helping families one by one, it’s time to help the thousands of families we’ve left behind in CA-34 and the millions of families left behind in the country due to the prioritization of corporate greed and short-term maximization of profits over the interests and wellbeing of the people. Poverty is killing our families, and we must stop turning a blind eye.

For the first time in history, UAW workers have gone on strike against the Big Three automakers all at once. | | | Peter — **Last night at midnight, for the first time in history, UAW workers went on strike against the Big Three automakers all at once.** Autoworkers at Ford, GM, and Stellantis are going on strike to demand better pay, increased job security for all, an end to substandard wages and benefits for recently hired workers, and to make sure that the green jobs of the future are good, union jobs. And in order to keep this strike going for the long haul, UAW is targeting individual plants that make some of the most profitable vehicles until the companies agree to pay workers their fair share. But the Big Three are still refusing to meet workers' demands — despite making _$21 billion_ in profits already this year. **[Can you join us and let striking UAW workers know we'll have their backs for as long as it takes? | | Peter,
---
| The Nebraska Progressives are spreading the narrative that School Choice will put public schools out of business.

Progressives argue this because they fail to realize the educational crisis. This crisis already threatens to erode children’s learning _further_ AND close schools!

Right now, special education teacher shortages at Omaha Public Schools are leaving parents with _no choice_. Their children have no options. This means their children have no future.

The lack of innovative problem solving on this issue will result in youth of all backgrounds missing out on a quality education. If our schools cannot provide the services our children need – how will they continue to pursue their dreams?

**The Republican Party of Nebraska is leading the charge for School Choice to empower Nebraska families with quality education options that nurture our children's God-given talents AND strengthen our communities. Here are some key highlights of the education portion of our legislative plan:**

**Protecting Children from Indoctrination and Pornography:** We believe in setting boundaries that allow parents to shield their children from harmful influences in the classroom.

**Funding Students, Not School Systems:** Our plan aims to empower parents by directing funding towards students, allowing them to choose the best education that suits their child's needs, whether it's public, private, or homeschooling.

**Expanding School Choice:** We are committed to expanding school choice by including K-12 schools in the Nebraska Educational Savings Plan, making quality education accessible to all families.

**Transparency in Education:** Parents have the right to see all curriculum materials used in their child's classroom, ensuring transparency and accountability.

**Vouchers for Underperforming Schools:** When a school fails to produce academically proficient students, parents should have the option to receive vouchers to seek a better education elsewhere.

We strongly believe that School Choice will empower schools to focus on nurturing academic excellence and this culture of focusing on educational exceptionalism will have ripple effects!

| Learning communities will strive to nurture academic performance to retain enrolled students, and families will be empowered to partner with educators for their child’s learning success! A culture of winning for all will be nurtured when students are funded instead of non-performing schools.

When we work together for the academic interests of our children – adults, children and our communities reap the benefits. **Peter, let’s get busy helping our children develop their academic potential by uniting to empower parents as force multipliers. Progressives argue this because they fail to realize the educational crisis. This crisis already threatens to erode children’s learning further AND close schools! The lack of innovative problem solving on this issue will result in youth of all backgrounds missing out on a quality education. If our schools cannot provide the services our children need – how will they continue to pursue their dreams? The Republican Party of Nebraska is leading the charge for School Choice to empower Nebraska families with quality education options that nurture our children's God-given talents AND strengthen our communities. Expanding School Choice: We are committed to expanding school choice by including K-12 schools in the Nebraska Educational Savings Plan, making quality education accessible to all families. Transparency in Education: Parents have the right to see all curriculum materials used in their child's classroom, ensuring transparency and accountability. body:
| | Hi all,

A grab bag of items for your attention this week.

**Vote by Mail Is Right Around the Corner**

Fall is in the air, pumpkin spice is everywhere, and this can only mean one thing: Vote by mail ballots are about to drop.

[Regardless of party affiliation, more and more New Jerseyans are choosing to vote by mail.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/69805072/427355470/2028096883?refcode=EM_NBI_DFD_20230915_OT_news_0_3MO_DG_na_na_newsletter&refcode2=af80201d-0654-ee11-9937-00224832e811&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82MzYzOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhZjgwMjAxZC0wNjU0LWVlMTEtOTkzNy0wMDIyNDgzMmU4MTEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=5Or8If0agFKrAaVVTBPNZ9rrsn9wK0-8HtBuMSqOsl4=&emci=a9b5af27-fe53-ee11-9937-00224832e811&emdi=af80201d-0654-ee11-9937-00224832e811&ceid=19214294) This means the next few weeks are vital for Board of Education candidates to get their names out to people in their communities. Every VBM ballot returned without a school board vote is a loss for the health of our communities and our public schools.

There are simple ways you can help: Write a letter to the editor about who you’re supporting in your local election and why. Talk to your neighbors. Email your friends. Send a postcard to people in town. Like and share candidate Facebook pages and other social media posts.

Name recognition is the biggest barrier to folks choosing to vote for BOE. The majority of people in your town – regardless of what you see in online forums – have no idea that New Jersey schools are facing the same censorship battles we see in Florida and Texas, or that there are bitterly contested races right here at home.

We must work together to ensure our neighbors know what’s at stake this year, and who our public school allies are.

**So Who Are the Candidates in Contested Races?**

Next week, we will post lists of contested races and suggested candidates to support in some (but not all) contested BOE races across New Jersey. We don’t have data for every contested race across the state, but we will continue to update our information between now and November to cover as many races as possible.

Districts for Democracy is not endorsing candidates, but together with other grassroots organizations we are working to identify candidates in contested races who align with our belief that public schools are a public good, and who are committed to supporting freedom of inquiry, thought, and speech for everyone.

**Moms for Liberty Endorsements**

We will also work to share endorsements by Moms for Liberty and other extremist organizations that spread misinformation, work to divide our communities, and undermine public schools.

This week, the Morris County chapter of Mom’s for Liberty issued its endorsements. This doesn’t mean there aren’t additional Morris candidates who align with the M4L agenda, but these are the people who are publicly doing so: The next few weeks will be some of the most important in 2023. I’m glad we’re working together to help our teachers, kids, and classrooms. Thank you all again for your attention, and your time. Let’s keep New Jersey public schools number one in the nation.

Sincerely,

Darcy
Executive Director
Districts for Democracy

| Districts for Democracy will work one school board, legislative, and congressional district at a time to recruit and support candidates committed to freedom of inquiry, thought, and speech for everyone. We want to keep the culture wars out of our schools, return school board elections to their nonpartisan roots, and keep our schools and universities focused on their central mission: helping our kids become educated and engaged citizens of these United States.

Send a postcard to people in town. Like and share candidate Facebook pages and other social media posts. Name recognition is the biggest barrier to folks choosing to vote for BOE. The majority of people in your town – regardless of what you see in online forums – have no idea that New Jersey schools are facing the same censorship battles we see in Florida and Texas, or that there are bitterly contested races right here at home. We must work together to ensure our neighbors know what’s at stake this year, and who our public school allies are. So Who Are the Candidates in Contested Races? Next week, we will post lists of contested races and suggested candidates to support in some (but not all) contested BOE races across New Jersey. We don’t have data for every contested race across the state, but we will continue to update our information between now and November to cover as many races as possible. Districts for Democracy is not endorsing candidates, but together with other grassroots organizations we are working to identify candidates in contested races who align with our belief that public schools are a public good, and who are committed to supporting freedom of inquiry, thought, and speech for everyone. Moms for Liberty Endorsements We will also work to share endorsements by Moms for Liberty and other extremist organizations that spread misinformation, work to divide our communities, and undermine public schools. This week, the Morris County chapter of Mom’s for Liberty issued its endorsements. This doesn’t mean there aren’t additional Morris candidates who align with the M4L agenda, but these are the people who are publicly doing so: The next few weeks will be some of the most important in 2023. I’m glad we’re working together to help our teachers, kids, and classrooms. Thank you all again for your attention, and your time. Let’s keep New Jersey public schools number one in the nation. Sincerely, Darcy Executive Director Districts for Democracy * | Districts for Democracy will work one school board, legislative, and congressional district at a time to recruit and support candidates committed to freedom of inquiry, thought, and speech for everyone. We want to keep the culture wars out of our schools, return school board elections to their nonpartisan roots, and keep our schools and universities focused on their central mission: helping our kids become educated and engaged citizens of these United States. = = Paid for by Districts for Democracy Districts for Democracy P.O. #
Hey Peter, it's Pramila!
I wanted to check in with you personally ahead of our mid-month deadline tonight at midnight.
Our finance team has been hard at work, trying to find the best ways to mobilize our grassroots base to help us hit our goal — but our fundraising has seen a significant slow down. **Take a look at our ActBlue progress this week:**
[****](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/45575?refcode=em20230915-2924&t=1&akid=2924%2E420207%2EW4fsrP)
Our fundraising has hit a massive decline since the start of the week — during a time where we need support the most.
Peter, we need your help in creating one final grassroots push ahead of our deadline to help us close the gap on our $7,255 goal. **[If you're able, please rush a donation of $5, $25, or whatever you're able to give to help us close the gap on our mid-month fundraising and help us keep planning for our future.](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/45575?refcode=em20230915-2924&t=2&akid=2924%2E420207%2EW4fsrP)**
**[Donate ››](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/45575?refcode=em20230915-2924&t=21&akid=2924%2E420207%2EW4fsrP)**
I know things in Washington are deeply chaotic and overwhelming right now — but I am determined to show up for my community each and every day.
Whether I'm putting the pressure on bad actors who fight against our values or bringing forth solutions to the many issues we all face every day,_I know that we can't afford to waste time in our fight for progress._
Your support has allowed this movement to grow and flourish into the powerhouse it is today. Each donation made is directed right back into strengthening our movement's resources to continue growing our momentum and sharing our progressive agenda with as many potential supporters as possible ahead of 2024.
Chipping in today will play a direct role in our ability to continue building our progressive momentum — not only to protect our campaign, but also to protect our hard-earned progress.
**[If you stand with us, please chip in $3 or more today to help us reach our mid-month goal of $7,255 and continue fighting for the progress our communities so desperately need and deserve.](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/45575?refcode=em20230915-2924&t=22&akid=2924%2E420207%2EW4fsrP)**
Let's do this,
Pramila Jayapal

| | Nothing mars a beautiful landscape like a pile of plastic trash. Plastic pollution threatens our right to a healthy environment and our ability to enjoy the vistas found only in our national parks, which include Oregon's Crater Lake. Single-use plastics degrade every national park, and inaction to protect these spaces is unacceptable. These unique parks are supposed to safeguard our country's natural beauty, and it is up to us to ensure the parks thrive for future generations to enjoy. In 2017, the Trump administration reversed Obama-era guidelines that allowed the National Park Service to ban the sale of single-use plastic water bottles in the parks. This policy diverted between 1.3 and 2 million disposable water bottles and prevented 111,743 pounds of plastic and 141 metric tons of greenhouse gas emissions from damaging our parks. We need to reinstate these guidelines, so I just introduced legislation to restore them and ban the sale of single-use plastic water bottles in our national parks to help protect their one-of-a-kind landscapes for generations to come. body:
They’re making ballot measure certification into an obstacle course. | [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/69806768/427360386/765663662?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNRlAvMS84NTQ3OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlM2MyOTcxZC0wYjU0LWVlMTEtOTkzNy0wMDIyNDgzMmU4MTEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=TB61ymMX5h1pTmDJPE4Ml6ljTiNp6jL0MVxtskdugIM=&emci=68af9465-0054-ee11-9937-00224832e811&emdi=e3c2971d-0b54-ee11-9937-00224832e811&ceid=561582) | Team, The rules for putting a ballot measure up for a vote should be simple: collect enough signatures from voters, those signatures are verified, and then you’re on the ballot! But new restrictions on ballot measures are constantly being built. When you make a contribution to GIFFORDS PAC, it’s the best way to send a strong message that you’re committed to our fight to end gun violence.

The landscape in Georgia is shifting - and the time for action is now. Just weeks ago, Donald Trump and 18 allies faced indictments over election-related actions. It's the result of individuals like you, standing firm in their beliefs and pushing for change. Voting your values - and valuing your right to vote.

Kat Cammack, the youngest Republican woman in Congress. She won the seat on a conservative platform of growing jobs, securing our southern border, standing up for law enforcement, defending our Second Amendment, promoting fiscal responsibility, and defending life.
Congresswoman Cammack, now in her second term, sits on the House Committee on Energy and Commerce and House Committee on Agriculture, where she is the only Florida Republican serving the Sunshine State's farmers, ranchers, and producers. She was also appointed to the Select Subcommittee on the Weaponization of the Federal Government.
Kat and her husband Matt, who is a firefighter, paramedic, and SWAT medic, proudly call Gainesville, Florida home.

We need to keep our foot on the gas from now until Election Day to ensure we don't fall behind for even a moment. But we can't do it without your support, team.

Hello friends!
We hope this edition of the New Pennsylvania Project eBlast finds you well.
Please take a few moments to check out all the important news you can use, career opportunities, and other updates.
Welcome James-Brian!
Graphic welcoming James-Brian Byers [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/AV/AV001/1/90920/images/NPP%20Social_2.jpg]
NPP CEO Kadida Kenner is excited to announce the addition of James-Brian Byers to the New Pennsylvania Project organizing team!
James-Brian Byers is the new Regional Organizing Director for the Allegheny County region.
A longtime resident of the city of Pittsburgh and Allegheny County, James-Brian is passionate about the importance of registering, encouraging, and activating those who feel that they have been left out of the American political system. James-Brian is passionate about building effective and impactful actions and campaigns that can do the work of the People. He has served in various positions in non-profits, politics, and government.
James-Brian is a veteran of the U.S. Air Force. He is an avid amateur athlete having completed several marathons, duathlons, and plays soccer, skis, and scuba dives whenever and wherever possible! James-Brian is a graduate of the MSW program at Temple University and resides in Allegheny County with his family.
Meet our entire team: https://www.newpaproject.org/npp-team/ [https://www.newpaproject.org/npp-team/]
NPP in the News
How Pennsylvania’s judicial elections could impact the state’s future [https://americanindependent.com/pennsylvania-supreme-court-election-2023/]
(The American Independent)
Though it may be an off-year for most elections, Pennsylvania voters will cast their ballot in several statewide elections in November that could have enormous consequences for the future of the state...State judicial elections don’t typically get much attention or voter turnout, especially if the election won’t change the balance of power in the court. The outcome of these elections, however, could have enormous implications down the line for the future of democracy in the Commonwealth because of how they’ll shape the partisan makeup of the courts for future elections.

(Chestnut Hill Local)
“There is an intersection between the issues you care about and our federal courts because they are pretty much the final arbitrator of all the things we care about,” Kadida Kenner added. “It’s important that we advocate... and we know about the process —- there’s so many more [people] who have no idea.”

(Bucks County Beacon)
"As a Black man in this country, I’m well aware of the importance of voting. It’s a responsibility of each eligible citizen/voter in this country. It not only allows for the voiceless to be heard, but it also bolsters the integrity of our democracy while shifting the electorate and subsequently our elected officials in a way that more accurately reflects the demographics of our country. A democracy depends on all of its citizens to be active in political and civic life. Part of that participation is voting. Unfortunately, 33 percent of all eligible Black men in Pennsylvania are not registered to vote."

_"Partisanship obscures what the extremes of both parties have in common."_ That was the opening line of my op-ed piece for the _Wall Street Journal_ , my friend. If you want proof of it – then look no further than the dysfunction of the Senate over what should have been business as usual for our senators. Just one Senator has been holding up the nomination of 301 generals and admirals over the Pentagon abortion policies. On the other side, Bernie Sanders has been holding up for key public health leadership positions, impacting critical areas like cancer research. _**Both sides keep holding our institutions hostage to score political points. **_ Both are distractions – but as a cancer survivor, I find the Left's hold on appointing Bertagnolli's nomination _**disgraceful.**_ We are making remarkable progress against the scourge of cancer. This appointment of an experienced leader should have been a cause for unity – not toxic political maneuvering. It should shock no one as to _**WHY**_ the American people have such little faith in Congress – as they continually force us to be spectators of their divisive political theater.

In the wake of Hurricane Katrina, Bill led a group of volunteers to convert an abandoned K-Mart building into an emergency healthcare facility.
As a conservative in the Senate, he focuses on the issues Louisiana families care about the most. Bill is working to lower the cost of health care, make flood insurance affordable, and save Social Security from a 24% cut if Washington fails to act.
Bill, and his wife, Laura, live in Baton Rouge and attend church at the Chapel on the Campus. They are blessed with three children and one grandchild.

name: Tom Fitton
subject: Illegal Biolabs in California
body:
Biden Impeachment Inquiry

[WEEKLY UPDATE]

ILLEGAL BIOLABS IN CALIFORNIA

[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=65056&L=30250&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvdmlkZW9zL2Jlc3Qtb2Ytd2lsbC1odW50ZXItZ28tdG8tamFpbC1kZWZ1bmQtdHJ1bXAtcHJvc2VjdXRpb25zLW1vcmUvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycw==&hash=2f11a9e1d21654c7d9a6ab6247fde02c4f0b11c56d9f0795b78e378060e37c4f]

HAZARDOUS CONDITIONS IN CALIFORNIA LABS OWNED BY CHINESE NATIONALS

Americans should know that dangerous biological research doesn’t
just occur in Wuhan. It is happening in the United States.

We received 29 pages
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=65056&L=30237&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2ZyZXNuby1jaGluZXNlLWxhYnMtY2FsaWZvcm5pYS1wdWJsaWMtcmVjb3Jkcy1hY3QtMjAyMy8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUFNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJz&hash=41c6fe67060cdf8a5e7cb5c6709df5b1bb9b5c5501f2f4bdea12f105047728d4]
of
records through the California Public Records Act confirming that
illicit labs owned by Chinese nationals housed biologicals in
hazardous and non-compliant conditions, multiple infectious agents,
and starving and dead mice. Our investigators also uncovered court
documents which detail the deplorable conditions at the lab (which
conducted “COVID” research), including photos of dead mice.

The documents were produced by the Fresno County Department of Public
Health (FCDPH) in response to a request for:

> Records and / or communications maintained by the Fresno County
> Public Health Department, including emails, email chains, email
> attachments, text messages, meeting minutes, interviews, voice
> recordings, video recordings, photographs, correspondence,
> statements, letters, memoranda, reports, briefings, affidavits,
> inspections, presentations, notes, or other form of record,
> regarding Prestige BioTech and Universal Meditech Inc.

Prestige Biotech reportedly
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=65056&L=30238&F=T&&hash=e00cb2ca55dbd734c5ce7a79f5192ef0f5d5c31facdef9076deed78c0aaf9071]
runs
Universal Meditech, Inc.

The records show that, on May 31, 2023, Dr. Rais Vohra
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=65056&L=30239&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuY29tbXVuaXR5Y2FyZWhlYWx0aC5vcmcvaW50ZXJpbS1oZWFsdGgtb2ZmaWNlci1kci1yYWlzLXZvaHJhLXByYWlzZWQtYXMtaGVhbHRoY2FyZS1oZXJvLz91dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9QU1qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNEJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj13ZWVrbHkrdXBkYXRlJnV0bV90ZXJtPW1lbWJlcnM=&hash=1afb76dab41a4d27c10b4f6d8971323bf0ed9a37e68e4656dbac55603871f219],
then-interim health officer for the Fresno County Department of Public
Health, had issued an order
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=65056&L=30240&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2ZyZXNuby1jaGluZXNlLWxhYnMtY2FsaWZvcm5pYS1wdWJsaWMtcmVjb3Jkcy1hY3QtMjAyMy1wZ3MtNi04Lz91dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9QU1qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNEJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj13ZWVrbHkrdXBkYXRlJnV0bV90ZXJtPW1lbWJlcnM=&hash=d90b7aead69a2a93c00d89edb4002ed5c68638888484d8970686bac2bab0e278]
to
Prestige to close its operations in Reedley, CA, and clean up
dangerous materials at the site:

> This Order is issued as a result of the City of Reedley’s attempts
> at gathering authorized representative contact information, repeated
> requests of complete lists of biologicals present, and an inspection
> pursuant to Health Officer Order dated April 21, 2023, which
> revealed biologicals in hazardous and non-compliant conditions, the
> presence of multiple infectious agents and pursuant to Title 17
> California Code of Regulations Section 2500, and multiple City of
> Reedley building and fire code violations, including but not limited
> to, failing refrigeration, and documented out of compliance
> electrical additions.

The records include an August 2023 PowerPoint presentation titled
“Healthy Fresno County, Better Together, Reedley Lab Update
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=65056&L=30251&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2ZyZXNuby1jaGluZXNlLWxhYnMtY2FsaWZvcm5pYS1wdWJsaWMtcmVjb3Jkcy1hY3QtMjAyMy1wZ3MtMTItMzIvXeKAnT91dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9QU1qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNEJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj13ZWVrbHkrdXBkYXRlJnV0bV90ZXJtPW1lbWJlcnM=&hash=36ed3f8ac4c0a2ca3a930328c1534af2e9f6317b530dead4976b7456987368ab
written by Fresno Co. Asst. Dir. Joe Prado
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=65056&L=30242&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cubGlua2VkaW4uY29tL2luL2pvZS1wcmFkby0zMjExYTQ4MS8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUFNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJz&hash=3408909c76eb68ae4e64bda067be47285d72a1df8e673f00cdac069fa132db5a].
The presentation
includes a section titled “City of Fresno Chronology of Events,”
which reports:

> August 26, 2020 – Universal MediTech location experienced a
> small fire.
>
> August 31, 2020 – Environmental Health CUPA inspection performed
> at Universal Meditech at 1320 E. Fortune Ave #102 in Fresno.
>
> EH Inspector conducted onsite visit and noted violations: failing to
> prepare and implement a hazardous materials business plan (HMBP) for
> storage of hazmat (ethanol) over state thresholds
>
> Permit was completed and valid from 9-1-2020 through 8-31-2021.
> Inspections are every 3 years from initial inspection,
> unless complaint is received.
>
> October 31, 2022 – FCDPH staff received a complaint from City of
> Fresno Code Enforcement and City Fire Department regarding chemicals
> stored at the Universal MediTech facility in Fresno.
>
> November 1, 2022 – FCDPH staff visited Universal MediTech site
> at 1320 E. Fortune Ave #102 in Fresno. Were not able to
> access facility.
>
> November 3, 2022 – FCDPH staff met City of Fresno Code Enforcement
> officer and property management at facility.
>
> November 8, 2022 – No response from general manager. FCDPH staff
> again visited Universal MediTech site but were again not able to
> access facility.
>
> November 8, 2022 – FCDPH staff received an email after visiting
> facility from Xiao XiaoWang, President/CEO of
> Universal MediTech Inc. regarding status of facility.
>
> November 10, 2022 – Email response to Xiao Xiao Wang regarding
> the hazardous materials storage and transportation requirements.
>
> November 23, 2022 – No response back from operators or
> CEO/President. FCDPH staff visited Universal MediTech facility and
> were again not able to access facility.

The presentation includes a section titled “Reedley Chronology
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=65056&L=30243&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2ZyZXNuby1jaGluZXNlLWxhYnMtY2FsaWZvcm5pYS1wdWJsaWMtcmVjb3Jkcy1hY3QtMjAyMy1wZ3MtMjMtMzIvXSzigJ0/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUFNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJz&hash=543b260fe311e8326d601ceaec8f67ea74adeee7da1c3c4c03ec91598454b023
which details the investigation of the lab after it relocated to
Reedley, CA:

> December 19, 2022 – City of Reedley Code Enforcement Officer
> contacted FCDPH regarding business found operating at 850 I Street.
>
> December 20, 2022 – Reedley Code Enforcement citing multiple code,
> building, and zoning violations for business, and had concerns
> regarding possible hazardous materials stored at facility.
>
> Emails with the Reedley Code Enforcement, CDPH, and FDA to
> coordinate a response.
>
> Reedley Code Enforcement and FCDPH contacted FBI regarding
> potential public safety risks.
>
> December 20, 2022 – FCDPH contacted FDA and CDPH requesting
> assistance regarding suspicious medical test manufacturing company.
>
> December 21, 2022 – FBI coordinated meeting with State, Federal
> and Local agencies and instructed the agencies to standby until
> conclusion of their investigation.
>
> January 2023 through February 2023 – Ongoing regular
> communication with Federal and State agencies.
>
> February 9, 2023 – FCDPH is informed by DTSC that FBI has given
> State and Local agencies approval to resume civil investigation.
>
> February 9, 2023 – Universal MediTech issues a nationwide recall
> of its COVID-19 test kits.
>
> February 24, 2023 – Multi-agency meeting to coordinate
> investigation of Prestige Biotech.
>
> CDPH Food & Drug Branch to take lead on investigation of medical
> devices.
>
> March 3, 2023 – FCDPH staff met at City of Reedley Fire Department
> with CDPH, DTSC, City of Reedley Police, Fire, Code Enforcement, and
> Building Inspector.
>
> ***
>
> City of Reedley posted Unsafe to Occupy Notice on front door of
> building.
>
> ***
>
> March 16, 2023 – FCDPH staff met with CDPH, DTSC, and City of
> Reedley and briefed on inspection warrant.
>
> Met with Consultant for Prestige Biotech.
>
> CDPH Food & Drug Branch staff went through and embargoed the
> unapproved medical test kits and medical supplies.
>
> ***
>
> March 22, 2023 – FCDPH meets with Health Officer, CAO, and BOS
> member on the Reedley Lab situation.
>
> State and Federal authorities stated that abatement is the
> County’s responsibility
>
> FCDPH emailed Prestige President requesting complete inventory of
> all materials onsite that pose a public safety risk.
>
> Communication and requests for inventory continued through April
> with incomplete and delayed responses from business representative.
>
> ***

> June 15, 2023 – Filed with Superior Court an Abatement Warrant to
> destroy all biologicals.
>
> June 23, 2023 – Judge of the Superior Court signs Abatement
> Warrant.
>
> June 26, 2023 – Abatement warrant issued by Superior Court.
>
> July 5-7, 2023 – Biological materials in approximately 36
> refrigerators/freezers were properly removed and transported for
> destruction by licensed contractor.

***

Under the heading “Next Steps,” the presentation notes that
investigations by the health department, FDA, California Department of
Public Health, the health department’s Food and Drug Branch, and the
U.S. Environmental Protection Agency were ongoing.

Our investigators also uncovered court documents that include
an abatement warrant
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=65056&L=30244&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2FiYXRlbWVudC13YXJyYW50LXJlZWRsZXlfZnJlc25vLWNhLWxhYnMtMjAyMy8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUFNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJz&hash=4d92a475a511f8ad896e9f2616a141c3391a3b591d9ec1293207f2b0f05a712e].
Exhibit
2 of the declaration of Code Enforcement Officer Jesalyn Harper
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=65056&L=30245&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cubGlua2VkaW4uY29tL2luL2plc2FseW4taGFycGVyLTc1NzFhNThiLz91dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9QU1qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNEJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj13ZWVrbHkrdXBkYXRlJnV0bV90ZXJtPW1lbWJlcnM=&hash=01075ea4c163df8dbdf0fa138ceec8306af006380d11da7bd48e0a82df5f60d2]
contains graphic
images
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=65056&L=30246&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2FiYXRlbWVudC13YXJyYW50LXJlZWRsZXlfZnJlc25vLWNhLWxhYnMtMjAyMy1wZ3MtODQtOTQvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycw==&hash=5cd89a9bdae047c66b95b63b32d77ff0ab9b07bc29c6e0abd524848f102fc064]
of
dead mice from the “mouse room” at the Reedley facility:

> Upon entering the mouse room, Code Enforcement and Dr. Hahn observed
> a large amount of mice feces on the floor. It was undeterminable
> if the feces were from wild mice or if the mice in the cages had
> begun to kick up feces out of the cages, but photos of the feces
> were taken regardless because according to Dr. Hahn it was very
> likely a mixture of both.
>
> Dr. Hahn confirmed the mice were in server distress because of
> “barbering” taking place, the high number of visible carcasses
> in the cages, and the lack of “pinkies.” Barbering is a social
> activity with mice consistent with over grooming. When under stress
> the dominant mice will begin to rip the hair and skin off the less
> dominant mice. The lack of pinkies can be related to starvation
> or stress, because Code Enforcement had been trying to provide
> adequate food and water it is believed the cannibalism is due to
> stress.
>
> Dr. Hahn recommended euthanasia due to the animal’s suffering
> and the lack of ability to provide adequate care for the animals.

In November 2022, we uncovered the Defense Department funding anthrax
laboratory
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=65056&L=28452&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9kLXJlY29yZHMtYW50aHJheC1sYWIvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycw==&hash=fc0cc0c78059c02f7bf6de87337f8def4b5be92a8c4d23db33463c810ebac2a1]
activities
in Ukraine. The records show over $11 million in funding for the
Ukraine biolabs program in 2019.

In June 2022, we uncovered records
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=65056&L=27447&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvaWxsZWdhbC1tb2xlY3VsYXItcmVzZWFyY2gvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycw==&hash=a1311b3b8d33ac6d1424b349515414edaf8347173cbf0a26bee594c04c541045]
from the
National Institutes of Health (NIH) revealing over two dozen cases
where research involving recombinant or synthetic nucleic acid (r/sNA)
molecules was conducted in America without proper approval and in
violation of NIH guidelines.
